title_en: RePo: Language Models with Context Re-Positioning
title_zh: RePo：带上下文重新定位的语言模型

sentences.en: In-context learning is fundamental to modern Large Language Models (LLMs); however, prevailing architectures impose a rigid and fixed contextual structure by assigning linear or constant positional indices.
sentences.zh: 上下文学习是现代大语言模型（LLM）的基础；然而，当前主流架构通过分配线性或常数的位置索引，施加了僵化且固定的上下文结构。

sentences.en: The rigid position information poses the full burden of organizing the input structure to attention layers, thus reducing the amount of attention that could be allocated for more critical information.
sentences.zh: 僵化的位置信息将组织输入结构的全部负担压在注意力层上，从而减少了可用于更关键信息的注意力分配。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose RePo, a novel mechanism that alleviates the burden for attention layers via context re-positioning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 RePo，一种通过上下文重新定位来减轻注意力层负担的新机制。

sentences.en: Unlike conventional approaches, RePo utilizes a differentiable module, $f_\phi$, to assign token positions that capture contextual dependencies, rather than replying on pre-defined order.
sentences.zh: 与常规方法不同，RePo 利用一个可微模块 $f_\phi$ 来分配能够捕获上下文依赖的词元位置，而不是依赖预定义顺序。

sentences.en: By continually pre-training on the OLMo-2 1B \& 7B  models, we demonstrate that RePo consistently enhances performance on tasks involving noisy contexts, structured data, and longer context length, while maintaining competitive performance on general short-context tasks.
sentences.zh: 通过在 OLMo-2 1B \& 7B 模型上的持续预训练，我们证明 RePo 在涉及噪声上下文、结构化数据与更长上下文长度的任务上持续提升性能，同时在一般短上下文任务上保持有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: Analysis reveals that RePo successfully allocates more attention mass to distant but relevant information, assigns positions in a dense and non-linear space, and captures the intrinsic structure of the input context.
sentences.zh: 分析表明，RePo 成功地将更多注意力集中在遥远但相关的信息上，在稠密且非线性的空间中分配位置，并捕获输入上下文的内在结构。

authors.name: Huayang Li
authors.institution: Nara Institute of Science and Technology

title_en: Repositioning the Subject within Image
title_zh: 在图像内重新定位主体

sentences.en: Current image manipulation primarily centers on static manipulation, such as replacing specific regions within an image or altering its overall style.
sentences.zh: 当前的图像操作主要集中于静态操作，例如替换图像中的特定区域或改变其整体风格。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce an innovative dynamic manipulation task, subject repositioning.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入一项创新的动态操作任务：主体重新定位。

sentences.en: This task involves relocating a user-specified subject to a desired position while preserving the image's fidelity.
sentences.zh: 该任务涉及将用户指定的主体重新定位到目标位置，同时保持图像的保真度。

sentences.en: Our research reveals that the fundamental sub-tasks of subject repositioning, which include filling the void left by the repositioned subject, reconstructing obscured portions of the subject and blending the subject to be consistent with surrounding areas, can be effectively reformulated as a unified, prompt-guided inpainting task.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究揭示，主体重新定位的基本子任务——包括填补被重新定位主体留下的空白、重建主体被遮挡的部分，以及将主体与周围区域混合一致——可以有效地重构为一个统一的、提示引导的图像修复任务。

sentences.en: Consequently, we can employ a single diffusion generative model to address these sub-tasks using various task prompts learned through our proposed task inversion technique.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们可以利用一个扩散生成模型，通过我们提出的任务反演技术学习到的各种任务提示来解决这些子任务。

sentences.en: Additionally, we integrate pre-processing and post-processing techniques to further enhance the quality of subject repositioning.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们集成了预处理与后处理技术，以进一步提升主体重新定位的质量。

sentences.en: These elements together form our SEgment-gEnerate-and-bLEnd (SEELE) framework.
sentences.zh: 这些元素共同构成了我们的 SEgment-gEnerate-and-bLEnd（SEELE）框架。

sentences.en: To assess SEELE's effectiveness in subject repositioning, we assemble a real-world subject repositioning dataset called ReS. Results of SEELE on ReS demonstrate its efficacy.
sentences.zh: 为评估 SEELE 在主体重新定位中的有效性，我们组装了一个真实世界的主体重新定位数据集 ReS。SEELE 在 ReS 上的结果证明了其有效性。

sentences.en: Code and ReS dataset are available at https://yikai-wang.github.io/seele/.
sentences.zh: 代码与 ReS 数据集可在 https://yikai-wang.github.io/seele/ 获取。

authors.name: Yanwei Fu
authors.institution: Fudan university, and Shanghai Innovation Institution

title_en: Representation Drift Compensation: A Near-Zero Inference Cost Enhancement for LLM Decomposition
title_zh: 表示漂移补偿：一种近乎零推理成本的 LLM 分解增强方案

sentences.en: While low-rank decomposition offers potential for reducing LLM parameters, maintaining the original capabilities remains a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 虽然低秩分解为减少 LLM 参数提供了潜力，但保持原有能力仍是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify and formalize a key overlooked issue in LLM decomposition: \textit{representation drift}.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们识别并形式化了 LLM 分解中一个被忽视的关键问题：\textit{representation drift}（表示漂移）。

sentences.en: We show that approximation errors introduced by decomposition propagate and amplify non-linearly through the deep layers of the transformer architecture, progressively distorting internal representations and degrading downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，由分解引入的近似误差会通过 transformer 架构的深层非线性地传播与放大，逐步扭曲内部表示并降低下游性能。

sentences.en: To mitigate this, we introduce a conceptually simple but principled compensation mechanism, named ``Decomper'', that operates by suppressing error at its source.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们引入一个概念上简单但具有原则性的补偿机制，名为 “Decomper”，它通过在源头抑制误差来运作。

sentences.en: By learning to align the output distribution of decomposed transformer blocks with their original counterparts, our method effectively counteracts representation drift, achieving notable performance recovery with near-zero inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 通过学习使被分解的 transformer 块的输出分布与其原始对应物对齐，我们的方法有效抵消了表示漂移，以近乎零的推理开销实现了显著的性能恢复。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments in OPT, LLaMA-2/3, and Qwen exhibit remarkable improvements.
sentences.zh: 在 OPT、LLaMA-2/3 与 Qwen 上的大量实验展现了显著的改进。

sentences.en: For instance, on LLaMA-3-8B and OPT-13B at 40\% compression, perplexity is reduced by more than 70\% while reasoning task accuracy improves by over 10\%.
sentences.zh: 例如，在 40\% 压缩率下的 LLaMA-3-8B 与 OPT-13B 上，困惑度降低了 70\% 以上，而推理任务准确率提升了超 10\%。

sentences.en: Our code is available at this \href{https://github.com/xinhaoH/SVD-Compen}{URL}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在此 \href{https://github.com/xinhaoH/SVD-Compen}{URL} 获取。

authors.name: Xinhao Huang
authors.institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

authors.name: Zeyi Wen
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

title_en: Representation Learning for Equivariant Inference with Guarantees
title_zh: 带保证的等变推断表示学习

sentences.en: In many real-world applications of regression, conditional probability estimation, and uncertainty quantification, exploiting symmetries rooted in physics or geometry can dramatically improve generalization and sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在许多回归、条件概率估计与不确定性量化的真实应用场景中，利用植根于物理或几何的对称性可以显著改善泛化能力与样本效率。

sentences.en: While geometric deep learning has made empirical advances by incorporating symmetry and geometry priors, less attention has been given to statistical learning guarantees.
sentences.zh: 虽然几何深度学习通过纳入对称性与几何先验已在实证上取得进展，但对于统计学习保证的关注较少。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce an equivariant representation learning framework that simultaneously addresses regression, conditional probability estimation, and uncertainty quantification while providing first-of-its-kind non-asymptotic statistical learning guarantees.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入一个等变表示学习框架，它同时处理回归、条件概率估计与不确定性量化，同时提供同类首创的非渐近统计学习保证。

sentences.en: Grounded in operator and group representation theory, our framework approximates the spectral decomposition of the conditional expectation operator, building representations that are both equivariant and disentangled along independent symmetry quotient groups.
sentences.zh: 以算子与群表示理论为基础，我们的框架近似条件期望算子的谱分解，构建既等变又在独立对称商群上解耦的表示。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations on synthetic datasets and real-world robotics applications confirm the potential of our approach, matching or outperforming existing equivariant baselines in regression while providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据集与真实世界机器人应用上的实证评估证实了我们方法的潜力，在回归上匹配或超越了现有的等变基线，同时提供了校准良好的不确定性估计。

authors.name: Alek Fröhlich
authors.institution: Università degli Studi di Genova, Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia

authors.name: Massimiliano Pontil
authors.institution: Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia and University College London

title_en: Representation Unlearning: Forgetting through Information Compression
title_zh: 表示遗忘：通过信息压缩实现遗忘

sentences.en: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of specific training data from a model, a need driven by privacy regulations and robustness concerns.
sentences.zh: 机器遗忘旨在从模型中移除特定训练数据的影响，这一需求由隐私法规与鲁棒性关切所驱动。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically modify model parameters, but such updates can be unstable, computationally costly, and limited by local approximations.
sentences.zh: 现有的方法通常修改模型参数，但这种更新可能不稳定、计算成本高昂，并受限于局部近似。

sentences.en: We introduce Representation Unlearning, a framework that performs unlearning directly in the model’s representation space.
sentences.zh: 我们引入表示遗忘（Representation Unlearning），一个直接在模型的表示空间中进行遗忘的框架。

sentences.en: Instead of modifying model parameters, we learn a transformation over representations that imposes an information bottleneck: maximizing mutual information with retained data while suppressing information about data to be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 与修改模型参数不同，我们学习一个对表示施加信息瓶颈的变换：最大化与保留数据的互信息，同时抑制关于待遗忘数据的信息。

sentences.en: We derive variational surrogates that make this objective tractable and show how they can be instantiated in two practical regimes: when both retain and forget data are available, and in a zero-shot setting where only forget data can be accessed.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出使这一目标易于处理的变分替代，并展示如何将它们实例化到两种实际场景中：当保留数据与遗忘数据都可用时，以及只能访问遗忘数据的零样本场景。

sentences.en: Experiments across several benchmarks demonstrate that Representation Unlearning achieves more reliable forgetting, better utility retention, and greater computational efficiency than parameter-centric baselines.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的实验表明，表示遗忘相比参数中心化的基线实现了更可靠的遗忘、更好的效用保留以及更高的计算效率。

authors.name: Alfonso Ortega
authors.institution: Aragon Institute for Engineering Research (I3A). Universidad de Zaragoza

title_en: Representational Curvature Modulates Behavioral Uncertainty in Large Language Models
title_zh: 表示曲率调节大语言模型中的行为不确定性

sentences.en: Temporal straightening describes how, across layers in autoregressive LLMs, the trajectory traced by the token representations of an input sequence becomes straighter, potentially enabling next-token prediction by linear extrapolation.
sentences.zh: 时间直线化（temporal straightening）描述了在自回归 LLM 的各层之间，由输入序列的词元表示所绘出的轨迹如何变得更直，这可能使得通过线性外推进行下一个词元预测成为可能。

sentences.en: However, a direct link between this trajectory and token-level behavior has been missing.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一轨迹与词元级行为之间的直接联系此前一直缺失。

sentences.en: We provide such a link by relating contextual curvature—a geometric measure of how sharply the representational trajectory bends over recent context—to next-token entropy.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将上下文曲率——一种度量表示轨迹在近期上下文上弯曲得有多尖锐的几何度量——与下一个词元熵关联起来，提供了这样一种联系。

sentences.en: Across two models (GPT-2 XL and Pythia-2.8B), contextual curvature is correlated with entropy, and this relationship emerges during training.
sentences.zh: 在两个模型（GPT-2 XL 与 Pythia-2.8B）上，上下文曲率与熵相关，且这种关系在训练过程中出现。

sentences.en: Perturbation experiments reveal selective dependence: manipulating curvature through trajectory-aligned interventions reliably modulates entropy, while geometrically misaligned perturbations have no effect.
sentences.zh: 扰动实验揭示了选择性的依赖：通过轨迹对齐的干预操纵曲率能够可靠地调节熵，而在几何上错位的扰动则没有效果。

sentences.en: Finally, regularizing representations to be straighter during training modestly reduces token-level entropy without degrading validation loss.
sentences.zh: 最后，在训练期间将表示正则化为更直，能够适度降低词元级熵，而不损害验证损失。

sentences.en: These results identify trajectory curvature as a task-aligned representational feature that influences behavioral uncertainty in LLMs.
sentences.zh: 这些结果将轨迹曲率识别为影响 LLM 行为不确定性的一种任务对齐的表示特征。

title_en: Representational Similarity and Model Behavior in Multi-Agent Interaction
title_zh: 多智能体交互中的表示相似性与模型行为

sentences.en: Researchers have shown that neural similarity among humans predicts social closeness and cooperative success, whereas innovation often emerges from interactions among dissimilar individuals.
sentences.zh: 研究者已经表明，人类之间的神经相似性能够预测社会亲近度与合作成功率，而创新往往源自不同个体之间的互动。

sentences.en: We investigate whether these principles extend to artificial intelligence by examining interactions between large language models.
sentences.zh: 我们通过考察大语言模型之间的互动，来研究这些原理是否适用于人工智能。

sentences.en: In our experiments, 276 model pairs interact across eight games spanning both cooperation and novelty.
sentences.zh: 在我们的实验中，276 对模型在涉及合作与新颖性的八个博弈中进行互动。

sentences.en: We find that pairs with more similar representation spaces achieve significantly higher cooperation but exhibit reduced novelty and creativity.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，表示空间更相似的对取得了显著更高的合作度，但表现出较低的新颖性与创造力。

sentences.en: The effects of representational similarity on cooperation and novelty remain robust even after controlling for other factors such as performance disparity and model size.
sentences.zh: 即使在控制了性能差异与模型规模等其他因素之后，表示相似性对合作与新意的影响仍然稳健。

sentences.en: We also find that similarity in the early layers consistently shows the strongest association with cooperation and novelty, compared to the middle and later layers.
sentences.zh: 我们还发现，相比中间层与深层，浅层中的相似性与合作及新意的关联始终最强。

sentences.en: This suggests that a central factor underlying these patterns could be the extent to which the two models share lexical and semantic grounding.
sentences.zh: 这表明，这些模式背后的一个核心因素可能是两个模型共享词汇与语义基础的程度。

sentences.en: Overall, representational similarity can be an important consideration in multi-agent system design.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，表示相似性可以成为多智能体系统设计中的一个重要考虑因素。

title_en: RePro: Training Language Models to Faithfully Recycle the Web for Pretraining
title_zh: RePro：训练语言模型忠实地回收网络数据用于预训练

sentences.en: High-quality data is a cornerstone of large language model (LLM) pretraining, yet its growth has not kept pace with the needs of frontier models.
sentences.zh: 高质量数据是大语言模型（LLM）预训练的基石，但其增长并未跟上前沿模型的需求步伐。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce RePro, a novel web recycling method that trains a relatively small LM with reinforcement learning to generate effective and faithful rephrasings of pretraining data.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入 RePro，一种新颖的网络回收方法，它用强化学习训练一个相对较小的 LM，为预训练数据生成有效且忠实的改写。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design one *quality* reward and three *faithfulness* rewards, optimizing the LM rephraser to convert organic data into high-quality rephrasings while maintaining its core semantics and structure.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们设计一个*质量*奖励与三个*忠实性*奖励，优化 LM 改写器将有机数据转换为高质量的改写，同时保持其核心语义与结构。

sentences.en: In our experiment, we train a rephraser as small as 1B parameters to recycle 72B tokens sampled from DCLM-RefinedWeb.
sentences.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们训练了一个小至 1B 参数的改写器，以回收从 DCLM-RefinedWeb 采样的 72B 词元。

sentences.en: Pretraining results on 400M, 1.4B, and 2.8B models demonstrate that RePro delivers 3.7\%-14.5\% relative accuracy gains over organic-only baseline on 22 downstream tasks, doubling the performance gains achieved by the state-of-the-art web recycling method that prompts a 70B rephraser.
sentences.zh: 在 400M、1.4B 与 2.8B 模型上的预训练结果证明，RePro 在 22 个下游任务上相比仅有有机数据的基线带来 3.7\%-14.5\% 的相对准确率提升，将最先进的、用 70B 改写器提示的网络回收方法所取得的性能提升翻了一番。

sentences.en: Experiments with different amounts of recycled data highlight that RePro improves organic data efficiency by 2-3$\times$.
sentences.zh: 不同回收数据量的实验强调，RePro 将有机数据效率提升了 2-3$\times$。

sentences.en: Individual and distributional analyses validate that RePro preserves more critical information and faithfully reflects the characteristics of organic data compared to prompting-based methods.
sentences.zh: 个体与分布分析验证，相比基于提示的方法，RePro 保留了更多关键信息，并忠实地反映了有机数据的特征。

sentences.en: Together, these results show that RePro provides an efficient and controllable path to effectively recycle organic data for pretraining.
sentences.zh: 总之，这些结果表明，RePro 为有效回收有机数据以用于预训练提供了一条高效且可控制的路径。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/cxcscmu/RePro.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/cxcscmu/RePro 获取。

authors.name: Chenyan Xiong
authors.institution: School of Computer Science, Carnegie Mellon University

title_en: ReQAT: Achieving Full-Precision Reasoning Accuracy with 4-bit Floating-Point Quantization-Aware Training
title_zh: ReQAT：以 4 位浮点量化感知训练实现全精度推理准确率

sentences.en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong problem-solving through long chain-of-thought, but their deployment is constrained by the high cost of full-precision inference and growing KV cache footprints.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）通过长长链的思维链实现强大的问题求解，但其部署受到全精度推理高昂成本与不断增长的 KV 缓存占用空间的制约。

sentences.en: Microscaled FP4 formats enable efficient FP4 deployment; however, fully quantizing weights, activations, and KV caches (W4A4KV4) causes severe reasoning degradation that existing PTQ and QAT fail to recover.
sentences.zh: 微缩标度 FP4 格式支持高效的 FP4 部署；然而，将权重、激活与 KV 缓存完全量化（W4A4KV4）会导致严重的推理退化，而现有的 PTQ 与 QAT 均无法恢复。

sentences.en: We identify that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens—precise symbolic commitments such as digits and operators—where quantization noise inflates sampling errors that cascade through reasoning traces.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出，FP4 的失效集中在低熵词元——例如数字与运算符这样的精确符号性投入——在这些地方，量化噪声放大了采样误差，并随推理链级联扩散。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose ReQAT, a reasoning-centric FP4 training framework with three components: (i) Trace-Aligned QAT (TAQ), which revisits identical reasoning traces to focus updates on critical low-entropy decisions;
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 ReQAT，一个以推理为中心的 FP4 训练框架，包含三个组件：（i）轨迹对齐 QAT（TAQ），它重新回顾相同的推理轨迹，将更新聚焦于关键的低熵决策；

sentences.en: (ii) Selective Entropy Minimization (SEM), which reinforces confidence at low-entropy positions; and (iii) Q-FIT, a quantization-friendly initialization that jointly calibrates RoPE-consistent KV cache transformations to stabilize QAT.
sentences.zh: （ii）选择性熵最小化（SEM），它强化低熵位置上的置信度；以及（iii）Q-FIT，一种量化友好的初始化，联合校准一致于 RoPE 的 KV 缓存变换以稳定 QAT。

sentences.en: Under the same training budget, ReQAT not only recovers but surpasses BF16 fine-tuning accuracy—achieving while delivering up to $3.9\times$ throughput speedup on NVIDIA DGX Spark and $3.1\times$ on B200.
sentences.zh: 在相同的训练预算下，ReQAT 不仅恢复而且超越了 BF16 微调准确率——在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上实现高达 $3.9\times$ 的吞吐量加速，在 B200 上实现 $3.1\times$。

sentences.en: This is the first demonstration that FP4 QAT can exceed full-precision accuracy for LRMs with over 3× speedup on production hardware.
sentences.zh: 这是首次证明 FP4 QAT 能够在生产硬件上以超过 3× 的加速超越 LRM 的全精度准确率。

title_en: Required Spine Optional Limbs: Heterogeneous Federated Learning via Backbone-sharing and Activation-guided Selection
title_zh: 必选主干、可选肢体：通过骨干共享与激活引导选择实现异构联邦学习

sentences.en: Although Federated Learning (FL) offers advantages in privacy-preserving for cross-device collaborative learning, its practical deployment remains severely constrained by heterogeneous hardware resources and non-IID (non-independent and identically distributed) data across devices.
sentences.zh: 虽然联邦学习（FL）在为跨设备协作学习提供隐私保护方面具有优势，但其实际部署仍受到设备间异构硬件资源与非独立同分布（non-IID）数据的严重制约。

sentences.en: Sub-model extraction has emerged as a widely adopted strategy for enabling collaborative training among devices with heterogeneous models.
sentences.zh: 子模型提取已成为一种被广泛采用的策略，用于在具有异构模型的设备之间实现协作训练。

sentences.en: However, existing sub-model extraction methods in FL typically rely on coarse-grained stochastic selection or rigid rule-based neuron selection, which severely limits training performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有 FL 中的子模型提取方法通常依赖粗粒度的随机选择或刚性的基于规则的神经元选择，这严重限制了训练性能。

sentences.en: Specifically, stochastic strategies lead to severe parameter conflicts under non-IID data distributions, while rule-based approaches lack diversity in neuron selection per device, preventing comprehensive parameter optimization.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，随机策略在非 IID 数据分布下导致严重的参数冲突，而基于规则的方法在每台设备的神经元选择上缺乏多样性，阻碍了全面的参数优化。

sentences.en: To address this problem, this paper presents a novel sub-model extraction-based FL framework, named SpineFL, which adopts a backbone-sharing mechanism and an activation-guided pruning strategy for sub-model extraction.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，本文提出一种基于子模型提取的新型 FL 框架，名为 SpineFL，它采用骨干共享机制与激活引导的剪枝策略进行子模型提取。

sentences.en: Specifically, SpineFL decomposes each global model layer into two portions: i) a mandatory backbone shared by all the sub-models to maintain model generalization, and ii) a dynamic portion for sub-model extraction.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，SpineFL 将每个全局模型层分解为两部分：（i）所有子模型共享的强制性骨干，以保持模型泛化能力；以及（ii）用于子模型提取的动态部分。

sentences.en: SpineFL adopts the activation-guided selection strategy to probabilistically select neurons according to their activation frequency from the dynamic portion to generate sub-model, where neurons exhibiting higher historical activation are more likely to be included, thereby simultaneously addressing parameter conflicts while preserving selection diversity.
sentences.zh: SpineFL 采用激活引导的选择策略，根据动态部分中神经元的激活频率概率性选择神经元以生成子模型，其中历史激活更高的神经元更可能被纳入，从而同时解决参数冲突并保持选择多样性。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that compared with state-of-the-art heterogeneous FL methods, SpineFL can achieve up to 3.28% accuracy improvement.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，与最先进的异构 FL 方法相比，SpineFL 可以实现高达 3.28% 的准确率提升。

title_en: Reranker Helps, but Not Enough: Towards Strong Poisoning Attacks Against Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: 重排序器有帮助，但还不够：面向检索增强生成的强投毒攻击

sentences.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) augments large language models with external knowledge, which in turn exposes their retrieval corpora to data poisoning risks.
sentences.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）利用外部知识增强大语言模型，这也使其检索语料库暴露于数据投毒风险之中。

sentences.en: However, existing poisoning attacks exhibit limited effectiveness against RAG equipped with a reranker to enhance retrieval quality.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的投毒攻击对配备了重排序器以提升检索质量的 RAG 效果有限。

sentences.en: Remarkably, this defensive capability requires no adversarial training: a reranker fine-tuned solely on benign, in-domain corpora can effectively filter malicious content.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，这种防御能力无需对抗训练：仅在良性、领域内语料库上微调的重排序器就能有效过滤恶意内容。

sentences.en: Towards realistic RAG red-teaming, we conclude practical prompt design principles that reveal reranker blind spots.
sentences.zh: 面向现实的 RAG 红队测试，我们总结了实际提示设计原则，揭示了重排序器的盲区。

sentences.en: Building on these insights, we introduce the Prompt-Perturbation Poisoning Attack ($\mathbf{P}^3 \mathbf{A}$).
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们引入提示扰动投毒攻击（$\mathbf{P}^3 \mathbf{A}$）。

sentences.en: $\mathbf{P}^3 \mathbf{A}$ first employs rule-based prompt engineering to craft initial poisoned texts.
sentences.zh: $\mathbf{P}^3 \mathbf{A}$ 首先采用基于规则的提示工程来构造初始的投毒文本。

sentences.en: It then injects subtle character-level perturbations into these texts, which promotes their ranking by the reranker while maintaining their adversarial effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 然后，它向这些文本注入微妙的字符级扰动，从而提升它们在重排序器中的排序，同时保持其对抗有效性。

sentences.en: These perturbations introduce only about 1\% textual change, ensuring the poisoned texts remain natural and readable.
sentences.zh: 这些扰动仅引入约 1\% 的文本改变，确保投毒文本保持自然与可读。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that $\mathbf{P}^3 \mathbf{A}$ achieves strong attack effectiveness and transferability, even when constrained to poisoning a single document.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，$\mathbf{P}^3 \mathbf{A}$ 实现了强大的攻击有效性与可迁移性，即使仅投毒单篇文档也是如此。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/YyyxKun/P3A.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/YyyxKun/P3A 获取。

title_en: ReSeek: A Self-Correcting Framework for Search Agents with Instructive Rewards
title_zh: ReSeek：带启发性奖励的搜索智能体自修正框架

sentences.en: Search agents powered by Large Language Models have demonstrated significant potential in tackling knowledge-intensive tasks.
sentences.zh: 由大语言模型驱动的搜索智能体在应对知识密集型任务方面展现出了巨大潜力。

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training these agents to perform complex, multi-step reasoning.
sentences.zh: 强化学习已成为训练这些智能体执行复杂、多步推理的一种强大范式。

sentences.en: However, prior RL-based methods often rely on sparse or rule-based rewards, which can lead agents to commit to suboptimal or erroneous reasoning paths without the ability to recover.
sentences.zh: 然而，先前的基于 RL 的方法常常依赖稀疏或基于规则的奖励，这可能导致智能体在不具备恢复能力的情况下陷入次优或错误的推理路径。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose **ReSeek**, a self-correcting framework enabling search agents to recover from erroneous search paths during an episode.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们提出 **ReSeek**，一个自修正框架，使搜索智能体能够在一次情节中从错误的搜索路径中恢复。

sentences.en: By invoking a special **JUDGE** action, the agent can judge the information and re-plan its search strategy.
sentences.zh: 通过调用一个特殊的 **JUDGE** 动作，智能体可以判断信息并重新规划其搜索策略。

sentences.en: To guide this process, we design a dense, instructive process reward function, which decomposes into a correctness reward for retrieving factual information and a utility reward for finding information genuinely useful for the query.
sentences.zh: 为引导这一过程，我们设计了一个稠密、有启发性的过程奖励函数，它分解为两个部分：用于检索事实信息正确性的正确性奖励，以及用于寻找对查询真正有用信息的效用奖励。

sentences.en: Additionally, to mitigate the risk of data contamination in existing datasets, we introduce **FictionalHot**, a contamination-free benchmark requiring complex reasoning.
sentences.zh: 此外，为缓解现有数据集中的数据污染风险，我们引入 **FictionalHot**，一个需要复杂推理、无污染的基准。

sentences.en: Experiments show ReSeek significantly outperforms SOTA baselines in task success and path faithfulness.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，ReSeek 在任务成功度与路径忠实性方面显著优于最先进基线。

title_en: Residual Context Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 残差上下文扩散语言模型

sentences.en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to purely autoregressive language models because they can decode multiple tokens in parallel.
sentences.zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）已成为纯自回归语言模型的一种有前景的替代方案，因为它们可以并行解码多个词元。

sentences.en: However, state-of-the-art block-wise dLLMs rely on a ``remasking" mechanism that decodes only the most confident tokens and discards the rest, effectively wasting computation.
sentences.zh: 然而，最先进的块级 dLLM 依赖一种 “remasking”（重新掩码）机制，只解码最自信的词元并丢弃其余部分，从而有效浪费了计算。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that recycling computation from the discarded tokens is beneficial, as these tokens retain contextual information useful for subsequent decoding iterations.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，回收被丢弃词元的计算是有益的，因为这些词元保留了可用于后续解码迭代的上下文信息。

sentences.en: In light of this, we propose Residual Context Diffusion (RCD), a module that converts these discarded token representations into contextual residuals and injects them back for the next denoising step.
sentences.zh: 有鉴于此，我们提出残差上下文扩散（Residual Context Diffusion，RCD），一个将这些被丢弃词元的表示转换为上下文残差并在下一个去噪步骤中将其注回模块。

sentences.en: RCD uses a decoupled two-stage training pipeline to bypass the memory bottlenecks associated with backpropagation.
sentences.zh: RCD 采用解耦的两阶段训练流水线，以绕过与反向传播相关的内存瓶颈。

sentences.en: We validate our method on both long CoT reasoning (SDAR) and short CoT instruction following (LLaDA) models.
sentences.zh: 我们在长 CoT 推理（SDAR）与短 CoT 指令遵循（LLaDA）模型上验证了我们的方法。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that a standard dLLM can be efficiently converted to the RCD paradigm with merely $\sim$300 million tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，一个标准 dLLM 只需约 $\sim$ 3 亿个词元即可高效转换为 RCD 范式。

sentences.en: RCD consistently improves frontier dLLMs by 4--11 percentage points in accuracy with minimal extra computation overhead across a wide range of benchmarks.
sentences.zh: RCD 在广泛的基准上以极小的额外计算开销，持续将前沿 dLLM 的准确率提升 4-11 个百分点。

sentences.en: Notably, on the most challenging AIME tasks, RCD nearly doubles baseline accuracy and attains up to 4--5x fewer denoising steps at baseline's peak accuracy.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在最具挑战性的 AIME 任务上，RCD 使基线准确率几乎翻倍，并在基线的峰值准确率下将去噪步数减少多达 4-5 倍。

title_en: Residual-Guided Multi-Resolution Refinement of Foundation Models: A Case Study in Drought Forecasting
title_zh: 基础模型的残差引导多分辨率细化：干旱预报案例研究

sentences.en: Regional climate prediction presents unique challenges for time series foundation models, which typically process temporal patterns through single-pass inference.
sentences.zh: 区域气候预测为时间序列基础模型带来了独特的挑战，这些模型通常通过单次推理来处理时间模式。

sentences.en: Expert climatologists, in contrast, employ multi-scale temporal analysis and iterative refinement based on systematic error diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，气候专家采用多尺度时间分析与基于系统性误差诊断的迭代细化。

sentences.en: We present RGMR (Residual-Guided Multi-Resolution Refinement), an inference-time framework that adapts pre-trained foundation models to perform structured coarse-to-fine refinement for climate forecasting without updating backbone parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 RGMR（残差引导的多分辨率细化），一个推理时框架，它将预训练的基础模型调整为执行结构化的从粗到细的细化以用于气候预测，而无需更新骨干参数。

sentences.en: Applied to drought forecasting using the Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI), RGMR is architecture-agnostic across the three TSFM backbones evaluated per site (TimesFM, TimeGPT, TabPFN) and consistently lowers test-set MSE on three South Australian sites and three additional regions outside South Australia.
sentences.zh: 将其应用于使用标准化降水蒸散发指数（SPEI）的干旱预报，RGMR 在所评估的每个站点的三种 TSFM 骨干（TimesFM、TimeGPT、TabPFN）上都是架构无关的，并在南澳大利亚的三个站点以及南澳大利亚以外的三个额外地区上一致地降低了测试集 MSE。

sentences.en: Applied to TimesFM, the wrapper reduces one-month-ahead SPEI MSE by up to 18.9\% across the three South Australian sites (mean reduction $\approx$18.7\%).
sentences.zh: 将其应用于 TimesFM，该包装器在三个南澳大利亚站点上将一个月前瞻的 SPEI MSE 最多降低了 18.9\%（平均降低 $\approx$18.7\%）。

sentences.en: Overall, RGMR provides a practical route for deploying frozen TSFMs in regional climate forecasting workflows.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，RGMR 为在区域气候预报工作流中部署冻结的 TSFM 提供了一条实用途径。

title_en: Resilient Coresets and Clustering
title_zh: 弹性核心集与聚类

sentences.en: Many machine learning problems are geometric at their core, relying on metric representations of data for tasks such as clustering, prototype selection, nearest-neighbor search, and graph-based learning.
sentences.zh: 许多机器学习问题在核心上都是几何问题，依赖数据的度量表示来完成聚类、原型选择、最近邻搜索与基于图的学习等任务。

sentences.en: Furthermore, data is  constantly evolving and it is routinely transformed through dimensionality reduction, random projections, feature embeddings, compression, or privacy-preserving mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 此外，数据在持续演化，并经常通过降维、随机投影、特征嵌入、压缩或隐私保护机制进行变换。

sentences.en: These transformations are designed to preserve geometry approximately.
sentences.zh: 这些变换被设计为近似保持几何结构。

sentences.en: As a  result, they preserve objective values for many geometric optimization  problems, but they fail to guarantee that algorithmic outcomes remain consistent.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们保持了许多几何优化问题的目标值，但无法保证算法的结果保持一致。

sentences.en: In this work, we study \emph{resilient data summaries}  for geometric optimization.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究用于几何优化的\emph{resilient data summaries}（弹性数据摘要）。

sentences.en: Building on the notion of \emph{$\gamma$-resilient algorithms} from Ahmadian, we introduce $\gamma$-resilient coresets.
sentences.zh: 基于 \emph{$\gamma$-弹性算法}的概念，我们引入 $\gamma$-弹性核心集。

sentences.en: A $\gamma$-resilient $(k,\varepsilon)$-coreset is a compact, weighted summary that guarantees a $(1+\varepsilon)$ approximation to the objective and enforces stability at the level of assignments.
sentences.zh: 一个$\gamma$-弹性 $(k,\varepsilon)$-核心集是一个紧凑的加权摘要，它保证对目标的 $(1+\varepsilon)$ 近似，并在分配层面强制执行稳定性。

sentences.en: We complement our positive result with a lower bound showing that to obtain a tight approximation for resilient clustering it is necessary to use a bi-criteria solution.
sentences.zh: 我们用下界补充了正面结果，表明要获得弹性聚类的一个紧致近似，有必要使用双准则解决方案。

title_en: Resolution as a Direction: Vector-Panning Feature Alignment for Cross-Resolution Re-Identification
title_zh: 以分辨率为方向：面向跨分辨率重识别的向量平移特征对齐

sentences.en: Cross-resolution person re-identification (CR-ReID) remains challenging in practical surveillance, where camera quality and capture distance lead to substantial resolution gaps between low-resolution (LR) queries and high-resolution (HR) gallery images.
sentences.zh: 跨分辨率行人重识别（CR-ReID）在实际监控中仍具挑战性，其中摄像头质量与拍摄距离导致低分辨率（LR）查询与高分辨率（HR）库图像之间存在显著的分辨率差距。

sentences.en: Prior approaches commonly rely on super-resolution (SR) or resolution-invariant representation learning, which often increases system complexity and may not directly address the feature mismatch induced by resolution degradation.
sentences.zh: 先前的方法通常依赖超分辨率（SR）或分辨率不变表示学习，这往往增加系统复杂性，并且可能无法直接解决由分辨率退化引起的特征失配。

sentences.en: In this work, we report a new empirical finding from a dedicated analysis in which identity-specific variation is averaged out: the HR--LR feature discrepancy produced by standard ReID backbones exhibits a consistent, resolution-related semantic direction in the embedding space.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从一项针对性的分析中报告一个新的实证发现（在该分析中，身份特有的变异被平均掉）：标准 ReID 骨干产生的 HR-LR 特征差异在嵌入空间中表现出一个一致的、与分辨率相关的语义方向。

sentences.en: We further support this observation with statistical analyses based on Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) and Pearson correlation analysis.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步基于典型相关分析（CCA）与 Pearson 相关分析，用统计分析支持这一观察。

sentences.en: Motivated by this finding, we propose Vector Panning Feature Alignment (VPFA), a lightweight post-hoc module that learns to pan LR features along the learned resolution direction to obtain pseudo-HR representations.
sentences.zh: 受这一发现的启发，我们提出向量平移特征对齐（Vector Panning Feature Alignment，VPFA），一个轻量级的后处理器模块，它学习沿所学的分辨率方向平移 LR 特征，以获得伪 HR 表示。

sentences.en: VPFA operates after feature extraction and can be integrated into existing ReID systems with negligible overhead.
sentences.zh: VPFA 在特征提取之后运行，可以零开销地集成到现有 ReID 系统中。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple CR-ReID benchmarks show that VPFA achieves state-of-the-art performance while improving efficiency compared to SR-based or jointly trained alternatives.
sentences.zh: 在多个 CR-ReID 基准上的大量实验表明，VPFA 实现了最先进的性能，同时相比基于 SR 或联合训练的替代方法提升了效率。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/ashmentlzw/VPFA}
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/ashmentlzw/VPFA} 获取。

title_en: Resolving Blind Inverse Problems under Dynamic Range Compression via  Structured Forward Operator Modeling
title_zh: 通过结构化前向算子建模解决动态范围压缩下的盲逆问题

sentences.en: Recovering radiometric fidelity from unknown dynamic range compression (UDRC), such as low-light enhancement and HDR reconstruction, is a challenging blind inverse problem, due to the unknown forward model and irreversible information loss introduced by compression.
sentences.zh: 从未知动态范围压缩（UDRC）中恢复辐射保真度，例如低光增强与 HDR 重建，是一个具有挑战性的盲逆问题，原因在于前向模型未知以及压缩引入的不可逆信息损失。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we first identify monotonicity as the fundamental physical invariant shared across UDRC tasks.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们首先识别出单调性是 UDRC 任务所共享的基本物理不变性。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we introduce the cascaded monotonic Bernstein (CaMB) operator to parameterize the unknown forward model.
sentences.zh: 利用这一洞见，我们引入级联单调 Bernstein（CaMB）算子来参数化未知的前向模型。

sentences.en: CaMB enforces monotonicity as a hard architectural inductive bias, constraining optimization to physically consistent mappings and enabling robust and stable operator estimation.
sentences.zh: CaMB 将单调性作为硬性的架构归纳偏置予以强制实施，将优化约束到物理一致的映射，并实现稳健且稳定的算子估计。

sentences.en: We further integrate CaMB with a plug-and-play diffusion framework, proposing CaMB-Diff.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将 CaMB 与一个即插即用的扩散框架集成，提出 CaMB-Diff。

sentences.en: Within this framework, the diffusion model serves as a powerful geometric prior for structural and semantic recovery, while CaMB explicitly models and corrects radiometric distortions through a physically grounded forward operator.
sentences.zh: 在该框架内，扩散模型作为结构与语义恢复的强大几何先验，而 CaMB 通过一个物理基础的前向算子显式建模并纠正辐射失真。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on a variety of zero-shot UDRC tasks, including low-light enhancement, low-field MRI enhancement, and HDR reconstruction, demonstrate that CaMB-Diff significantly outperforms state-of-the-art zero-shot baselines in terms of both signal fidelity and physical consistency.
sentences.zh: 在多种零样本 UDRC 任务（包括低光增强、低场 MRI 增强与 HDR 重建）上的大量实验表明，CaMB-Diff 在信号保真度与物理一致性两方面都显著优于最先进的零样本基线。

sentences.en: Moreover, we empirically validate the effectiveness of the proposed CaMB parameterization in accurately modeling the unknown forward operator.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们实证验证了所提出 CaMB 参数化在精确建模未知前向算子方面的有效性。

title_en: Resolving the Timestep Scaling Paradox in Spiking Neural Networks with a Timestep-Scalable Neuron Model
title_zh: 用时间步可缩放神经元模型解决脉冲神经网络中的时间步缩放悖论

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have garnered attention for their biological plausibility, energy efficiency, and temporal modeling capability.
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）因其生物合理性、能量效率与时序建模能力而备受关注。

sentences.en: Due to the non-differentiability of spike generation, a widely used training method for SNNs is backpropagation through time with surrogate gradients, achieving competitive performance with few timesteps.
sentences.zh: 由于脉冲生成不可微，SNN 的一种广泛使用的训练方法是带代理梯度的时序反向传播，在少量时间步下即可取得有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: Intuitively, scaling timesteps should improve performance by enriching temporal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 直觉上，缩放时间步应该通过丰富时序动态来提升性能。

sentences.en: However, we observe timestep scaling paradox (TSP), a counter-intuitive accuracy degradation when scaling timesteps.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们观察到时间步缩放悖论（TSP），即缩放时间步时出现反直觉的准确率下降。

sentences.en: We investigate TSP and link it to long-term temporal gradient vanishing and weakened cross-timestep dependencies.
sentences.zh: 我们研究了 TSP，并将其与长期时序梯度消失以及跨时间步依赖的减弱联系起来。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose the Timestep-Scalable (TS) neuron model.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出时间步可缩放（Timestep-Scalable，TS）神经元模型。

sentences.en: It introduces long-term memory reconsolidation to enhance cross-timestep information flow and enable effective learning with more timesteps.
sentences.zh: 它引入长期记忆再巩固以增强跨时间步的信息流，并在更多时间步下实现有效的学习。

sentences.en: In parallel, a temporal forgetting mechanism periodically truncates the accumulation path, suppressing excessive temporal buildup and improving training stability.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一种时序遗忘机制周期性地截断累积路径，抑制过度的时序累积并提高训练稳定性。

sentences.en: Supported by theoretical analysis and extensive experiments, TS consistently improves performance when scaling timesteps.
sentences.zh: 在理论分析与大量实验的支持下，TS 在缩放时间步时一致地提升性能。

sentences.en: In addition, it attains state-of-the-art results on time-series and event-based tasks, while remaining strong on static image classification and object detection.
sentences.zh: 此外，它在时序与基于事件的任务上取得了最先进的结果，同时在静态图像分类与目标检测上保持强劲。

title_en: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement for Reasoning Large Language Models via Dynamic One-Shot Policy Refinement
title_zh: 通过动态一次策略细化实现推理型大语言模型的资源高效强化

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have exhibited remarkable performance on complex reasoning tasks, with reinforcement learning under verifiable rewards (RLVR) emerging as a principled framework for aligning model behavior with reasoning chains.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在复杂推理任务上展现了卓越的性能，可验证奖励下的强化学习（RLVR）已成为将模型行为与推理链对齐的一种有原则的框架。

sentences.en: Despite its promise, RLVR remains prohibitively resource-intensive, requiring extensive reward signals and incurring substantial rollout costs during training.
sentences.zh: 尽管前景广阔，RLVR 仍极其消耗资源，需要大量的奖励信号，并在训练期间产生大量滚出成本。

sentences.en: In this work, we revisit the fundamental question of data and compute efficiency in RLVR.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们重新审视 RLVR 中数据与计算效率这一基本问题。

sentences.en: We first establish a theoretical lower bound on the sample complexity required to unlock reasoning capabilities, and empirically validate that strong performance can be achieved with a surprisingly small number of training instances.
sentences.zh: 我们首先为解锁推理能力所需的样本复杂度建立一个理论下界，并实证验证，用数量惊人的少量训练实例即可实现强大性能。

sentences.en: To tackle the computational burden, we propose Dynamic One-Shot Policy Refinement (DoPR), a uncertainty-aware RL strategy that dynamically selects a single informative training sample per batch for policy updates, guided by reward volatility and exploration-driven acquisition.
sentences.zh: 为应对计算负担，我们提出动态一次策略细化（Dynamic One-Shot Policy Refinement，DoPR），一种不确定性感知的 RL 策略，它在奖励波动性与探索驱动的采集的引导下，为每次梯度更新动态地选择单个信息量最大的训练样本。

sentences.en: DoPR reduces rollout overhead by nearly an order of magnitude while preserving competitive reasoning accuracy, offering a scalable and resource-efficient solution for LLM post-training.
sentences.zh: DoPR 将滚出开销减少近一个数量级，同时保持有竞争力的推理准确率，为 LLM 后训练提供了一种可扩展且资源高效的解决方案。

sentences.en: This approach offers a practical path toward more efficient and accessible RL-based training for reasoning-intensive LLM applications.
sentences.zh: 这一方法为面向推理密集型 LLM 应用的更高效、更易得的基于 RL 的训练提供了一条实际路径。

title_en: Respecting Modality Gap in Post-hoc Out-of-distribution Detection with Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 在预训练视觉-语言模型的事后分布外检测中尊重模态差距

sentences.en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection has emerged as a popular technique to enhance the reliability of machine learning models by identifying unexpected inputs from unknown classes.
sentences.zh: 分布外（OOD）检测已成为一种流行的技术，通过识别来自未知类别的意外输入来提升机器学习模型的可靠性。

sentences.en: Recent progress in pre-trained vision–language models (VLMs) has enabled zero-shot OOD detection without access to in-distribution (ID) training data; in this setting, existing methods commonly treat text embeddings of class names as class prototypes.
sentences.zh: 预训练视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的最新进展使零样本 OOD 检测成为可能，且无需访问分布内（ID）训练数据。在这一设定下，现有方法通常将类别名称的文本嵌入视为类别原型。

sentences.en: In this paper, we challenge this widely adopted “text-as-prototype” paradigm by theoretically showing that off-the-shelf textual prototypes are generally misaligned with the optimal visual prototypes, yielding an intrinsic \textit{modality gap} that cannot be eliminated by prompt engineering alone.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们挑战这一被广泛采用的“text-as-prototype”范式，从理论上证明现成的文本原型通常与最优视觉原型不对齐，从而产生无法仅凭提示工程消除的内在 \textit{模态差距}（modality gap）。

sentences.en: To mitigate this gap under the post-hoc constraint, this paper presents an online pseudo-supervised framework that directly learns class prototypes in the visual feature space using unlabeled test-time data streams and soft predictions from the pre-trained VLMs.
sentences.zh: 为了在事后（post-hoc）约束下缓解这一差距，本文提出了一个在线伪监督框架，利用无标注的测试时数据流和预训练 VLM 的软预测，直接在视觉特征空间中学习类别原型。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees for the convergence of the online optimization procedure.
sentences.zh: 我们为在线优化过程的收敛性提供了理论保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments empirically manifest that our method achieves a new state of the art across a variety of OOD detection setups.
sentences.zh: 大量实验实证表明，我们的方法在多种 OOD 检测设定下都取得了新的最佳性能（state of the art）。

title_en: ReSpinQuant: Efficient Layer-Wise LLM Quantization via Subspace Residual Rotation Approximation
title_zh: ReSpinQuant：通过子空间残差旋转近似实现高效的分层 LLM 量化

sentences.en: Rotation-based Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising solution for mitigating activation outliers in the quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 基于旋转的训练后量化（Post-Training Quantization, PTQ）已成为一种有前景的解决方案，用于在大语言模型（LLMs）量化中缓解激活值离群点（activation outliers）问题。

sentences.en: Global rotation methods achieve inference efficiency by fusing activation rotations into attention and FFN blocks, but suffer from limited expressivity as they are constrained to use a single learnable rotation matrix across all layers.
sentences.zh: 全局旋转方法通过将激活值旋转融合进注意力（attention）和 FFN 模块来实现推断效率，但因受限于在所有层中使用单一可学习的旋转矩阵而表达能力有限。

sentences.en: To tackle this, layer-wise transformation methods emerged, achieving superior accuracy through localized adaptation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，分层变换方法应运而生，通过局部适配实现了更高的精度。

sentences.en: However, layer-wise methods cannot fuse activation rotation matrices into weights, requiring online computations and causing significant overhead.
sentences.zh: 然而，分层方法无法将激活值旋转矩阵融合进权重，需要在线计算，从而带来显著开销。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose **ReSpinQuant**, a quantization framework that resolves such overhead by leveraging offline activation rotation fusion and matching basis using efficient residual subspace rotation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 **ReSpinQuant**，一个量化框架，通过利用离线的激活值旋转融合，并使用高效的残差子空间旋转来匹配基，从而消除此类开销。

sentences.en: This design reconciles the high expressivity of layer-wise adaptation with only negligible inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 这种设计在保持分层适配高表达能力的同时，仅带来可忽略的推断开销。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on W4A4 and W3A3 quantization demonstrate that ReSpinQuant achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming global rotation methods and matching the accuracy of computationally expensive layer-wise methods with minimal overhead.
sentences.zh: 在 W4A4 和 W3A3 量化上的大量实验表明，ReSpinQuant 取得了最先进的性能，优于全局旋转方法，并以极小的开销达到计算成本高昂的分层方法的精度。

title_en: Responsible Text-to-Image Diffusion: Interpretable and Linearly Controllable Semantics for Fair and Safe Generation
title_zh: 负责任的文生图扩散模型：面向公平与安全生成的可解释且线性可控语义

sentences.en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models (DMs) have achieved remarkable generative quality but still exhibit risk of producing biased and inappropriate images.
sentences.zh: 文生图（T2I）扩散模型（DMs）已取得卓越的生成质量，但仍存在生成有偏颇和不当图像的风险。

sentences.en: A promising line of prior work aims to mitigate this issue by learning interpretable, linearly controllable concepts from semantic spaces, such as the U-Net bottleneck; however, these methods rely entirely on U-Net architectures and cannot be generalized to modern ViT-based DMs, including FLUX and PixArt.
sentences.zh: 一条有前景的先前工作路线旨在从语义空间（如 U-Net 瓶颈层）中学习可解释、线性可控的概念来缓解这一问题。然而，这些方法完全依赖 U-Net 架构，无法推广到基于 ViT 的现代扩散模型，包括 FLUX 和 PixArt。

sentences.en: In this work, we present an architecture-agnostic framework for discovering interpretable and linearly controllable semantic attributes across any T2I DM backbone.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一个与架构无关的框架，可在任意 T2I 扩散模型主干中发现可解释且线性可控的语义属性。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that multi-modal attention heads in ViT-based DMs exhibit a linear semantic structure: injected concept vectors combine linearly at the attention level and induce near-linear effects at the model output, satisfying homogeneity and additivity.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们证明基于 ViT 的扩散模型中的多模态注意力头表现出线性语义结构：注入的概念向量在注意力层面线性组合，并在模型输出处引发近线性效应，满足齐次性和可加性。

sentences.en: These theoretical results are aligned with and supported by empirical experiments.
sentences.zh: 这些理论结果与实证实验一致并得到其支持。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we introduce a method that learns external concept vectors, which are added to the multi-modal attention heads for ViT-based DMs or to the bottleneck layer for U-Net-based DMs, while keeping pretrained models frozen.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出一种学习外部概念向量的方法，将其添加到基于 ViT 的扩散模型的多模态注意力头，或添加到基于 U-Net 扩散模型的瓶颈层，同时保持预训练模型冻结。

sentences.en: Experiments across SDXL, SD3.5, PixArt, and FLUX demonstrate that these concept vectors provide interpretability, linearity, and significantly improved fairness while preserving visual fidelity.
sentences.zh: 在 SDXL、SD3.5、PixArt 和 FLUX 上的实验表明，这些概念向量在保持视觉保真度的同时，提供了可解释性、线性以及显著改善的公平性。

sentences.en: The code and demo are available at https://github.com/Moslem-Sh21/responsible-t2i-diffusion.
sentences.zh: 代码和演示可在 https://github.com/Moslem-Sh21/responsible-t2i-diffusion 获取。

title_en: ResRL: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Negative Sample Projection Residual Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: ResRL：通过负样本投影残差强化学习增强 LLM 推理

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) enhances reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) but usually exhibits limited generation diversity due to the over-incentivization of positive rewards.
sentences.zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）能增强大型语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力，但由于对正向奖励的过度激励，通常表现出有限的生成多样性。

sentences.en: Although methods like Negative Sample Reinforcement (NSR) mitigate this issue by upweighting penalty from negative samples, they may suppress the semantic distributions shared between positive and negative responses.
sentences.zh: 尽管诸如负样本强化（Negative Sample Reinforcement, NSR）之类的方法通过提高负样本惩罚来缓解这一问题，但它们可能会抑制正向与负向响应之间共享的语义分布。

sentences.en: To boost reasoning ability without losing diversity, this paper proposes negative sample projection Residual Reinforcement Learning (ResRL) that decouples similar semantic distributions among positive and negative responses.
sentences.zh: 为了在提升推理能力的同时不损失多样性，本文提出负样本投影残差强化学习（ResRL），它对正向与负向响应中相似的语义分布进行解耦。

sentences.en: We theoretically link Lazy Likelihood Displacement (LLD) to negative-positive head-gradient interference and derive a single-forward proxy that upper-bounds representation alignment to guide conservative advantage reweighting.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上将懒惰似然位移（Lazy Likelihood Displacement, LLD）与负-正头梯度干扰联系起来，并推导出一个单次前向代理，用它上界表征对齐，以指导保守的优势重加权。

sentences.en: ResRL then projects negative-token hidden representations onto an SVD-based low-rank positive subspace and uses projection residuals to modulate negative gradients, improving reasoning while preserving diversity and outperforming strong baselines on average across twelve benchmarks spanning Mathematics, Code, Agent Tasks, and Function Calling.
sentences.zh: ResRL 随后将负 token 的隐表征投影到基于 SVD 的低秩正子空间上，并利用投影残差来调节负梯度，从而在保持多样性、改善推理的同时，在涵盖数学、代码、智能体任务和函数调用等十二个基准上平均优于强基线。

sentences.en: Notably, ResRL surpasses NSR on mathematical reasoning by 9.4\% in Avg@16 and 7.0\% in Pass@128.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，ResRL 在数学推理上以 Avg@16 指标提升 9.4\% 、以 Pass@128 指标提升 7.0\% 超越了 NSR。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/1229095296/ResRL.git.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/1229095296/ResRL.git 获取。

title_en: REST: Diffusion-based Real-time End-to-end Streaming Talking Head Generation via ID-Context Caching and Asynchronous Streaming Distillation
title_zh: REST：通过身份上下文缓存与异步流式蒸馏实现的、基于扩散的实时端到端流式说话头部生成

sentences.en: Diffusion models have significantly advanced the field of talking head generation (THG).
sentences.zh: 扩散模型已显著推进了说话头部生成（THG）领域。

sentences.en: However, slow inference speeds and prevalent non-autoregressive paradigms severely constrain the application of diffusion-based THG models.
sentences.zh: 然而，缓慢的推理速度与普遍的非自回归范式严重制约了基于扩散的 THG 模型的应用。

sentences.en: In this study, we propose REST, a pioneering diffusion-based, real-time, end-to-end streaming audio-driven talking head generation framework.
sentences.zh: 在本研究中，我们提出 REST，一个开创性的、基于扩散的、实时的、端到端流式音频驱动的说话头部生成框架。

sentences.en: To support real-time end-to-end generation, a compact video latent space is first learned through a spatiotemporal variational autoencoder with a high compression ratio.
sentences.zh: 为支持实时的端到端生成，首先通过一个具有高压缩比的时空变分自编码器学习一个紧凑的视频潜在空间。

sentences.en: Additionally, to enable semi-autoregressive streaming within the compact video latent space, we introduce an ID-Context Cache mechanism, which integrates ID-Sink and Context-Cache principles into key-value caching for maintaining identity consistency and temporal coherence during long-term streaming generation.
sentences.zh: 此外，为在紧凑的视频潜在空间中实现半自回归流式生成，我们引入身份上下文缓存（ID-Context Cache）机制，它将 ID-Sink 与 Context-Cache 原理融入键值缓存，以在长期流式生成期间保持身份一致性与时间连贯性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, an Asynchronous Streaming Distillation (ASD) strategy is proposed to mitigate error accumulation and enhance temporal consistency in streaming generation, leveraging a non-streaming teacher with an asynchronous noise schedule to supervise the streaming student.
sentences.zh: 进一步地，我们提出异步流式蒸馏（ASD）策略，以缓解流式生成中的误差累积并增强时间一致性，它利用带异步噪声调度的非流式教师来监督流式学生。

sentences.en: REST bridges the gap between autoregressive and diffusion-based approaches, achieving a breakthrough in efficiency for applications requiring real-time THG.
sentences.zh: REST 弥合了自回归方法与基于扩散方法之间的差距，在需要实时 THG 的应用中实现了效率上的突破。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that REST outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both generation speed and overall performance.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，REST 在生成速度与整体性能两方面都优于最先进的方法。

title_en: Resting Neurons, Active Insights: Robustifying Activation Sparsity in LLMs via Spontaneity
title_zh: 静息神经元，活跃洞见：通过自发性增强大语言模型中的激活稀疏性鲁棒性

sentences.en: Activation sparsity offers a compelling route to accelerate large language model (LLM) inference by selectively suppressing hidden activations, yet existing approaches exhibit severe accuracy degradation at high sparsity.
sentences.zh: 激活稀疏性通过选择性地抑制隐藏激活，为大语言模型（LLM）推理加速提供了一条极具吸引力的途径，然而现有方法在高稀疏度下会出现严重的准确率下降。

sentences.en: We show that this failure stems from representational instability: *activation sparsity disrupts input-dependent activation learned during pretraining, inducing distribution shifts in hidden states*.
sentences.zh: 我们证明这一失败源于表征不稳定性：*激活稀疏性破坏了预训练期间学到的与输入相关的激活，导致隐藏状态产生分布偏移*。

sentences.en: We address this issue by reframing activation sparsity as a representational alignment problem and introducing **Spontaneous Neurons (SPON)**, a lightweight mechanism inspired by spontaneous neural activity in biological systems.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将激活稀疏性重新定义为表征对齐问题，并引入**自发神经元（SPON）**——一种受生物系统中自发神经活动启发的轻量级机制——来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: SPON injects a small set of learnable, input-independent activation vectors that act as persistent representational anchors for sparse computation.
sentences.zh: SPON 注入一组数量极少、可学习且与输入无关的激活向量，它们充当稀疏计算的持久表征锚点。

sentences.en: These vectors are trained via distribution matching to the dense model and can be absorbed into bias terms after training, incurring negligible inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 这些向量通过分布匹配的方式针对稠密模型进行训练，训练后可以被吸收进偏置项中，从而带来可忽略不计的推理开销。

sentences.en: Across multiple LLM backbones, SPON consistently restores performance, stabilizes latent representations, and preserves generalization.
sentences.zh: 在多个 LLM 主干网络上，SPON 始终能够恢复性能、稳定潜在表征并保持泛化能力。

sentences.en: Our results establish SPON as an effective and principled solution for reliable activation-sparse inference, and offer new insights into knowledge retention in LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验结果确立了 SPON 作为可靠的激活稀疏推理的一种有效且原理性强的解决方案，并为 LLM 中的知识保留提供了新的见解。

title_en: Restoring Exploration after Post-Training: Latent Exploration Decoding for Large Reasoning Models
title_zh: 后训练后恢复探索：面向大型推理模型的潜在探索解码

sentences.en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have recently achieved strong mathematical and code reasoning performance through Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）近来通过强化学习（RL）后训练在数学与代码推理上取得了强劲的性能。

sentences.en: However, we show that modern reasoning post-training induces an unintended exploration collapse: temperature-based sampling no longer increases pass@$n$ accuracy.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们表明，现代推理后训练会诱发一种非预期的探索崩溃：基于温度的采样不再提升 pass@$n$ 准确率。

sentences.en: Empirically, the final-layer posterior of post-trained LRMs exhibit sharply reduced entropy, while the entropy of intermediate layers remains relatively high.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，后训练 LRM 的末层后验表现出急剧降低的熵，而中间层的熵则保持相对较高。

sentences.en: Motivated by this entropy asymmetry, we propose Latent Exploration Decoding (LED), a depth-conditioned decoding strategy.
sentences.zh: 基于这种熵不对称性，我们提出潜在探索解码（Latent Exploration Decoding，LED），一种深度条件化的解码策略。

sentences.en: LED aggregates intermediate posteriors via cumulative sum and selects depth configurations with maximal entropy as exploration candidates.
sentences.zh: LED 通过累积求和聚合中间层后验，并选择具有最大熵的深度配置作为探索候选。

sentences.en: Without additional training or parameters, LED consistently improves pass@1 and pass@16 accuracy by 0.61 and 1.03 percentage points across multiple reasoning benchmarks and models.
sentences.zh: 无需额外训练或参数，LED 在多个推理基准与模型上将 pass@1 与 pass@16 准确率一致地提升了 0.61 与 1.03 个百分点。

sentences.en: Relevant code is included in the supplementary material and will made be fully public after this paper is accepted.
sentences.zh: 相关代码包含在补充材料中，并将在本文被接收后完全公开。

title_en: Restoring Initial Noise Sensitivity in Text-to-Image Distillation through Geometric Alignment
title_zh: 通过几何对齐恢复文本到图像蒸馏中的初始噪声敏感性

sentences.en: Generative distillation significantly accelerates text-to-image (T2I) generation by compressing multi-step trajectories into few-step student models while preserving perceptual quality.
sentences.zh: 生成式蒸馏通过将多步轨迹压缩成少步学生模型，同时保持感知质量，显著加速了文本到图像（T2I）生成。

sentences.en: However, existing methods primarily optimize efficiency and output fidelity, often neglecting critical properties of the original trajectory.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要优化效率与输出保真度，常常忽视原始轨迹的关键属性。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify a key missing property: sensitivity to initial noise, whose degradation impairs downstream control methods relying on noise-based optimization and manipulation.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们识别出一个关键缺失属性：对初始噪声的敏感性，其退化会损害依赖基于噪声的优化与操纵的下游控制方法。

sentences.en: We trace this issue to standard distillation objectives that enforce pointwise output alignment, inadvertently flattening the input-output landscape and suppressing the teacher’s local geometric structure.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一问题追溯到标准蒸馏目标，它们强制逐点输出对齐，不经意间压平了输入-输出图景，并抑制了教师的局部几何结构。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Geometry-Aware Distillation (GAD), a sensitivity-preserving framework that aligns the local functional behavior of teacher and student models.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出几何感知蒸馏（Geometry-Aware Distillation，GAD），一个保持敏感性的框架，它对齐教师与学生模型的局部函数行为。

sentences.en: Specifically, GAD matches Jacobian-vector products with respect to input noise, enabling the student to reproduce the teacher’s differential response to perturbations.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，GAD 匹配关于输入噪声的雅可比-向量积，使学生能够再现教师对扰动的微分响应。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple T2I paradigms and noise-driven control tasks demonstrate that GAD significantly restores sensitivity and improves diversity while maintaining high visual fidelity.
sentences.zh: 在多种 T2I 范式与噪声驱动控制任务上的大量实验表明，GAD 显著恢复了敏感性并提升了多样性，同时保持高视觉保真度。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Hannah1102/GAD.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Hannah1102/GAD 获取。

title_en: ReTabSyn: Realistic Tabular Data Synthesis via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: ReTabSyn：通过强化学习实现逼真的表格数据合成

sentences.en: Deep generative models can help with data scarcity and privacy by producing synthetic training data, but they struggle in low-data, imbalanced tabular settings to fully learn the complex data distribution.
sentences.zh: 深度生成模型可以通过产生合成训练数据来应对数据稀缺与隐私问题，但在低数据量、不平衡的表格场景中，它们难以完全学到复杂的数据分布。

sentences.en: We argue that striving for the full joint distribution could be overkill; for greater data efficiency, models should prioritize learning the conditional distribution $P(y\mid \mathbf{X})$, as suggested by recent theoretical analysis.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，追求完整的联合分布可能有些过度；为获得更高的数据效率，模型应优先学习条件分布 $P(y\mid \mathbf{X})$，正如最近的理论分析所建议的那样。

sentences.en: Therefore, we overcome this limitation with ReTabSyn, a Reinforced Tabular Synthesis pipeline that provides direct feedback on feature correlation preservation during synthesizer training.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们通过 ReTabSyn（增强型表格合成流水线）克服了这一局限，它在合成器训练期间提供关于特征相关性保持的直接反馈。

sentences.en: This objective encourages the generator to prioritize the most useful predictive signals when training data is limited, thereby strengthening downstream model utility.
sentences.zh: 这一目标鼓励生成器在训练数据有限时优先考虑最有用的预测信号，从而增强下游模型的效用。

sentences.en: We empirically fine-tune a language model-based generator using this approach, and across benchmarks with small sample sizes, class imbalance, and distribution shift, ReTabSyn consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们使用这一方法对基于语言模型的生成器进行实证微调，在样本量小、类别不平衡与分布偏移的基准上，ReTabSyn 一致地优于最先进基线。

sentences.en: Moreover, our approach can be readily extended to control various aspects of synthetic tabular data, such as applying expert-specified constraints on generated observations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的方法可以很容易地扩展到控制合成表格数据的各个方面，例如对生成的观测施加专家指定的约束。

title_en: Retaining by Doing: The Role of On-Policy Data in Mitigating Forgetting
title_zh: 做中学以记忆：在策略数据在缓解遗忘中的作用

sentences.en: Adapting language models (LMs) to new tasks via post-training carries the risk of degrading existing capabilities -- a phenomenon classically known as catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 通过后训练将语言模型（LM）适配到新任务会带来降低已有能力的风险——这一现象在经典上被称为灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: In this paper, toward identifying guidelines for mitigating this phenomenon, we systematically compare the forgetting patterns of two widely adopted post-training methods: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL).
sentences.zh: 在本文中，为寻找缓解这一现象的准则，我们系统地比较了两种被广泛采用的后训练方法的遗忘模式：有监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）。

sentences.en: Our experiments reveal a consistent trend across LM families (Llama, Qwen) and tasks (instruction following, general knowledge, and arithmetic reasoning): RL leads to less forgetting than SFT while achieving comparable or higher target task performance.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验揭示了跨 LM 家族（Llama、Qwen）与任务（指令遵循、通用知识与算术推理）的一致趋势：RL 相比 SFT 遗忘更少，同时取得相当或更高的目标任务性能。

sentences.en: To investigate the cause for this difference, we consider a simplified setting in which the LM is modeled as a mixture of two distributions, one corresponding to prior knowledge and the other to the target task.
sentences.zh: 为调查这一差异的原因，我们考虑一个简化的设定，其中 LM 被建模为两种分布的混合，一种对应先验知识，另一种对应目标任务。

sentences.en: We identify that the mode-seeking nature of RL, which stems from its use of on-policy data, enables keeping prior knowledge intact when learning the target task.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出，RL 的峰值搜索（mode-seeking）特性源于其对在策略数据的使用，这使得在学习目标任务时能够保持先验知识完好。

sentences.en: We then verify this insight by demonstrating that the use on-policy data underlies the robustness of RL to forgetting in practical settings, as opposed to other algorithmic choices such as the KL regularization or advantage estimation.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们通过论证在实践设定中在策略数据的使用是 RL 对遗忘鲁棒性的基础（而非 KL 正则化或优势估计等其他算法选择），来验证这一洞见。

sentences.en: Lastly, as a practical implication, our results highlight the potential of mitigating forgetting using approximately on-policy data, which can be substantially more efficient to obtain than fully on-policy data.
sentences.zh: 最后，作为一个实际启示，我们的结果突显了使用近似在策略数据来缓解遗忘的潜力，这类数据相比完全在策略数据可以更高效地获得。

title_en: Rethink the Role of Neural Decoders in Quantum Error Correction
title_zh: 重新思考神经解码器在量子纠错中的作用

sentences.en: Quantum error correction (QEC) is essential for enabling quantum advantages, with decoding as a central algorithmic primitive.
sentences.zh: 量子纠错（QEC）对于实现量子优势至关重要，其中解码是一项核心算法原语。

sentences.en: Owing to its importance and intrinsic difficulty, substantial effort has been made to QEC decoder design, among which neural decoders have recently emerged as a promising data-driven paradigm.
sentences.zh: 鉴于其重要性与内在困难，人们为 QEC 解码器设计付出了大量努力，其中神经解码器近来作为一种有前景的数据驱动范式而兴起。

sentences.en: Despite this progress, practical deployment remains hindered by a fundamental accuracy–latency tradeoff, often on the microsecond timescale.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，实际部署仍受制于一个根本的准确率-延迟权衡，其时间尺度通常在微秒量级。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, here we revisit neural decoders for surface-code decoding under explicit accuracy–latency constraints, considering code distances up to $d=9$ (161 physical qubits).
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，在此我们重新审视在显式准确率-延迟约束下用于表面码解码的神经解码器，考虑码距最大至 $d=9$（161 个物理量子比特）。

sentences.en: We unify and redesign representative neural decoders into five architectural paradigms and develop an end-to-end compression pipeline to evaluate their deployability and performance on FPGA hardware.
sentences.zh: 我们将具有代表性的神经解码器统一并重新设计为五种架构范式，并开发一个端到端压缩流水线，以在 FPGA 硬件上评估它们的可部署性与性能。

sentences.en: Through systematic experiments, we reveal several previously underexplored insights: (i) near-term decoding performance is driven more by data scale than architectural complexity; (ii) appropriate inductive bias is essential for achieving high decoding accuracy; and (iii) INT4 quantization is a prerequisite for meeting microsecond-scale latency requirements on FPGAs.
sentences.zh: 通过系统的实验，我们揭示了几项此前未被充分探索的洞见：（i）近期解码性能更由数据规模而非架构复杂度驱动；（ii）适当的归纳偏置对于实现高解码准确率至关重要；以及（iii）INT4 量化是满足 FPGA 上微秒级延迟要求的先决条件。

sentences.en: Together, these findings provide concrete guidance toward scalable and real-time neural QEC decoding.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，这些发现为可扩展、实时的神经 QEC 解码提供了具体指导。

title_en: Rethinking 1-bit Optimization Leveraging Pre-trained Large Language Models
title_zh: 重新思考利用预训练大语言模型的 1 位优化

sentences.en: 1-bit LLM quantization offers significant advantages in reducing storage and computational costs.
sentences.zh: 1 位 LLM 量化在减少存储与计算成本方面提供了显著优势。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically train 1-bit LLMs from scratch, failing to fully leverage pre-trained models.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常从零开始训练 1 位 LLM，未能充分利用预训练模型。

sentences.en: This results in high training costs and notable accuracy degradation.
sentences.zh: 这导致了高昂的训练成本与显著的准确率退化。

sentences.en: We identify that the large gap between full precision and 1-bit representations makes naive adaptation difficult.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出，全精度与 1 位表示之间的巨大差距使得天真的适配变得困难。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce a consistent progressive training for both forward and backward, smoothly converting the full-precision weights into the binarized ones.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入一种前向与后向都一致的渐进式训练，将全精度权重平滑地转换为二值化权重。

sentences.en: Additionally, we incorporate binary-aware initialization and dual-scaling compensation to reduce the difficulty of progressive training and improve the performance.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们纳入二进制感知初始化与双缩放补偿，以降低渐进式训练的难度并提升性能。

sentences.en: Experimental results on LLMs of various sizes demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 在多种规模的 LLM 上的实验结果表明，我们的方法优于现有方法。

sentences.en: Our results show that high-performance 1-bit LLMs can be achieved using pre-trained models, eliminating the need for expensive training from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，利用预训练模型即可实现高性能的 1 位 LLM，从而无需昂贵的从零训练。

title_en: Rethinking 3D Shape Generation: Diffusion over Superquadrics
title_zh: 重新思考 3D 形状生成：超二次曲面上的扩散

sentences.en: Diffusion models have advanced 3D shape generation, yet most methods still denoise in high-cardinality spaces (e.g., voxel/SDF grids, meshes, or point clouds), which is computationally and memory intensive and makes it difficult to scale in terms of both higher resolution and stronger controllability.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型已推进了 3D 形状生成，但大多数方法仍在高基数空间中（例如体素/SDF 网格、网格或点云）进行去噪，这在计算与内存上都十分密集，并且在更高分辨率与更强可控性方面难以扩展。

sentences.en: We rethink the diffusion representation and propose to move diffusion from dense geometry to compact geometric primitives, representing each shape as a small set of **superquadrics**.
sentences.zh: 我们重新思考扩散的表示，并提出将扩散从稠密几何迁移到紧凑的几何基元，将每个形状表示为一个小集合的 **superquadrics**（超二次曲面）。

sentences.en: Instead of operating on thousands to millions of geometric representation values, we leverage 7KB superquadric parameters (pose, size, and shape), drastically reducing diffusion-state dimensionality and per-step compute/memory.
sentences.zh: 与其在数千到数百万个几何表示值上操作，我们利用 7KB 的超二次曲面参数（位姿、尺寸与形状），大幅降低了扩散状态的维度以及每步的计算与内存。

sentences.en: Our diffusion-over-superquadrics improves scalability by supporting broader capabilities (e.g., resolution-free point-cloud decoding, part-level editing, and constraint-based design) and achieving competitive surface-fidelity and distributional performance on standard benchmarks after point-cloud decoding, while enabling efficient generation within 0.6s per shape for most conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们的超二次曲面扩散通过支持更广泛的能力（例如无分辨率点云解码、部件级编辑与基于约束的设计）提升了可扩展性，并在点云解码后在标准基准上取得了有竞争力的表面保真度与分布性能，同时在大多数条件下在每形状 0.6 秒内实现高效生成。

title_en: Rethinking Attention in Spiking Transformers: Overcoming Density Bias with Set Similarity
title_zh: 重新思考脉冲 Transformer 中的注意力：用集合相似度克服密度偏倚

sentences.en: Recent Spiking Transformer models have explored a variety of attention mechanisms beyond standard dot-product formulations.
sentences.zh: 近期的脉冲 Transformer 模型已经探索了超越标准点积形式的各种注意力机制。

sentences.en: However, many existing similarity-based spiking attention formulations remain inherently sensitive to firing density, causing neurons with high spike rates to dominate attention scores regardless of semantic relevance.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多现有的基于相似度的脉冲注意力形式本质上对发放密度敏感，导致高发放率的神经元无论语义相关性如何都主导注意力分数。

sentences.en: This density bias is particularly problematic in event-driven spiking representations, where sparse spike patterns often carry critical information.
sentences.zh: 这种密度偏倚在事件驱动的脉冲表示中尤其成问题，因为稀疏的脉冲模式往往携带关键信息。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we rethink spiking attention from a set-theoretic perspective.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们从集合论的视角重新思考脉冲注意力。

sentences.en: We propose DiceFormer, a novel Spiking Transformer architecture driven by Spike Dice Attention (SDA).
sentences.zh: 我们提出 DiceFormer，一个由脉冲 Dice 注意力（SDA）驱动的新型脉冲 Transformer 架构。

sentences.en: Unlike traditional approaches, SDA replaces density-sensitive measures with a set similarity function derived from the Dice coefficient.
sentences.zh: 与传统方法不同，SDA 用从 Dice 系数导出的集合相似度函数取代对密度敏感的度量。

sentences.en: By explicitly normalizing for firing density, SDA focuses on spike co-occurrence rather than high firing rates.
sentences.zh: 通过显式地对发放密度进行归一化，SDA 关注脉冲共现而非高发放率。

sentences.en: We primarily evaluate DiceFormer on the challenging audio domain, where spike sparsity varies substantially across inputs.
sentences.zh: 我们主要在具有挑战性的音频领域评估 DiceFormer，在该领域中，各输入之间的脉冲稀疏度差异很大。

sentences.en: On AudioSet-20k, DiceFormer achieves a SOTA mAP of 0.161 with 54.3M parameters, outperforming prior SNN-based approaches and substantially narrowing the performance gap with ANN-based models.
sentences.zh: 在 AudioSet-20k 上，DiceFormer 以 54.3M 参数取得了 0.161 的最先进 mAP，优于先前的基于 SNN 的方法，并大幅缩小了与基于 ANN 的模型的性能差距。

sentences.en: We also introduce Lin-SDA, a linearized version for computation efficiency, while achieving performance comparable to SDA.
sentences.zh: 我们还引入 Lin-SDA，一个用于计算效率的线性化版本，同时实现了与 SDA 相当的性能。

sentences.en: Beyond audio, we evaluate the effectiveness of SDA on CIFAR-100 to verify its applicability to the vision domain.
sentences.zh: 除音频之外，我们还在 CIFAR-100 上评估 SDA 的有效性，以验证其对视觉领域的适用性。

title_en: Rethinking Calibration for Early-Exit Neural Networks
title_zh: 重新思考早退神经网络的校准

sentences.en: Early-exit neural networks (EENNs) accelerate inference by allowing intermediate classifiers to stop computation once predictions are confident enough.
sentences.zh: 早退神经网络（EENN）通过允许中间分类器在预测足够自信时停止计算来加速推理。

sentences.en: Most methods rely on confidence thresholds for exiting, and consequently, improving classifier calibration is widely assumed to improve performance.
sentences.zh: 大多数方法依赖置信度阈值来决定退出，因此，人们普遍假设改进分类器校准能够改进性能。

sentences.en: In this work, we challenge this assumption and show that calibration alone is not sufficient for EENNs to exploit adaptive computation.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们质疑这一假设，并表明仅靠校准不足以让 EENN 利用自适应计算。

sentences.en: To address this insufficiency, we introduce Early-Exit Failure Prediction (EEFP), which accounts for both prediction correctness and the cost of further computation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一不足，我们引入早退失败预测（Early-Exit Failure Prediction，EEFP），它同时考虑预测正确性与进一步计算的成本。

sentences.en: We also propose a lightweight, EEFP-motivated procedure to improve the intermediate classifiers, which can directly replace calibration in EENNs.
sentences.zh: 我们还提出一个轻量级的、受 EEFP 启发的流程来改进中间分类器，它可以直接替代 EENN 中的校准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves superior cost-accuracy trade-offs compared to calibration, and EEFP more reliably reflects overall EENN performance.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法相比校准取得了更优的成本-准确率权衡，且 EEFP 更可靠地反映 EENN 的整体性能。

sentences.en: Our code is available at [https://github.com/gmum/rethinking-calibration-for-eenns](https://github.com/gmum/rethinking-calibration-for-eenns).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 [https://github.com/gmum/rethinking-calibration-for-eenns](https://github.com/gmum/rethinking-calibration-for-eenns) 获取。

title_en: Rethinking Code Complexity Through the Lens of Large Language Models
title_zh: 从大语言模型的视角重新思考代码复杂度

sentences.en: Code complexity metrics such as cyclomatic complexity have long been used to assess software quality and maintainability.
sentences.zh: 诸如圈复杂度之类的代码复杂度指标长期以来一直被用于评估软件质量与可维护性。

sentences.en: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) on coding tasks, an important yet underexplored question arises: do traditional complexity metrics meaningfully characterize the coding difficulty that LLMs perceive?
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在编码任务上的快速进步，一个重要但鲜少被探索的问题浮现：传统的复杂度指标能否有意义地刻画 LLM 所感知的编码难度？

sentences.en: In this work, we empirically demonstrate that classical complexity metrics exhibit no consistent correlation with LLM performance, revealing a fundamental mismatch with model-perceived difficulty.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们实证表明，经典复杂度指标与 LLM 性能之间没有一致的关联，揭示出它们与模型感知难度之间存在根本的不匹配。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we propose LM-CC, a novel code complexity metric tailored for LLMs, grounded in the hypothesis that model-perceived code difficulty is fundamentally driven by semantic nonlinearity.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出 LM-CC，一个为 LLM 定制的新型代码复杂度指标，其基础假设是：模型感知的代码难度根本上由语义非线性驱动。

sentences.en: LM-CC quantifies complexity through an entropy-guided semantic compositional hierarchy, capturing the cumulative uncertainty encountered by LLMs during code understanding.
sentences.zh: LM-CC 通过一个熵引导的语义组合层次结构来量化复杂度，捕获 LLM 在代码理解过程中遇到的总不确定性。

sentences.en: Our experimental results demonstrate that LM-CC exhibits strong and consistent partial correlations with LLM performance, while semantics-preserving reductions in LM-CC consistently lead to improved downstream task performance.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验结果表明，LM-CC 与 LLM 性能表现出强且一致的偏相关，而保持语义的 LM-CC 降低一致地带来下游任务性能的提升。

sentences.en: The source code is available at: https://github.com/xchen121/lm-cc.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在：https://github.com/xchen121/lm-cc 获取。

title_en: Rethinking Contrastive Learning for Graph Collaborative Filtering: Limitations and a Simple Remedy
title_zh: 重新思考图协同过滤中的对比学习：局限与一个简单的补救方案

sentences.en: Graph collaborative filtering (GCF) is a dominant paradigm in recommender systems, where contrastive learning (CL) objectives such as the Sampled Softmax (SSM) loss are widely used for optimization.
sentences.zh: 图协同过滤（GCF）是推荐系统中的主流范式，其中诸如采样软最大（SSM）损失之类的对比学习（CL）目标被广泛用于优化。

sentences.en: However, it remains unclear how CL interacts with the prediction mechanism of GCF.
sentences.zh: 然而，CL 如何与 GCF 的预测机制相互作用仍不清楚。

sentences.en: By unfolding the prediction mechanism of GCF, we show that the user-item prediction score is computed by aggregating learnable weights over a large number of neighbor pairs formed by the multi-hop neighbors of the user and the item.
sentences.zh: 通过展开 GCF 的预测机制，我们表明，用户-物品预测分数是通过在由用户与物品的多跳邻居构成的大量邻居对上聚合可学习权重而计算得到的。

sentences.en: This analysis suggests that effective optimization critically depends on which neighbor pairs are upweighted during training.
sentences.zh: 这一分析表明，有效优化关键取决于训练期间哪些邻居对被抬高权重。

sentences.en: Empirically, we find that effective recommendation is achievable by selectively upweighting only a small subset of neighbor pairs whose constituent neighbors are structurally similar to the target user and item, and that the effect of such selective upweighting varies across different neighbor pair types.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，我们发现，通过有选择地仅抬高一小部分邻居对（其组成邻居与目标用户和物品在结构上相似）的权重，即可实现有效的推荐，并且这种选择性加权的效果在不同邻居对类型之间有所不同。

sentences.en: Based on these findings, we analyze SSM and identify key limitations in its neighbor pair weight update dynamics.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们分析了 SSM，并识别出其在邻居对权重更新动态方面的关键局限。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose NT-SSM, an effective and principled CL objective that induces type-aware neighbor pair weight update dynamics.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们提出 NT-SSM，一个有效且有原则性的 CL 目标，它引入类型感知的邻居对权重更新动态。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements over SSM across multiple datasets and GCF models.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在多个数据集与 GCF 模型上，相比 SSM 取得了持续的性能提升。

title_en: Rethinking Convergence in MoE Training: The Role of Routing Sparsity
title_zh: 重新思考 MoE 训练中的收敛：路由稀疏性的作用

sentences.en: In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training, sparse routing, i.e., activating only the top-$K$ experts per token, is essential for balancing convergence speed and computational cost.
sentences.zh: 在混合专家（MoE）训练中，稀疏路由，即每个词元仅激活 top-$K$ 专家，对于平衡收敛速度与计算成本至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing works typically choose $K$ empirically, without theoretical guidance.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有工作通常凭经验选择 $K$，缺乏理论指导。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we characterize the convergence behavior of MoE training using stochastic optimization theory.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们利用随机优化理论刻画 MoE 训练的收敛行为。

sentences.en: Specifically, we derive a convergence upper bound of $\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1+M/K}{\sqrt{T}}\right)$, where $T$ is the number of training iterations and $M$ is the total number of experts per MoE layer.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们推导出一个收敛上界 $\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{1+M/K}{\sqrt{T}}\right)$，其中 $T$ 是训练迭代次数，$M$ 是每个 MoE 层的专家总数。

sentences.en: This result guarantees convergence and shows that increasing $K$ can accelerate training.
sentences.zh: 这一结果保证了收敛，并表明增大 $K$ 可以加速训练。

sentences.en: By further fixing the total computational budget $R$ (in FLOPs), we obtain a refined bound of $\mathcal{O}\left(\sqrt{\frac{K}{R}} + \frac{M}{\sqrt{K R}}\right)$, which is convex in $K$ and implies the existence of an optimal $K^{*}\in[1,M]$ that achieves the best convergence performance.
sentences.zh: 通过进一步固定总计算预算 $R$（以 FLOPS 计），我们得到一个改进了的界 $\mathcal{O}\left(\sqrt{\frac{K}{R}} + \frac{M}{\sqrt{K R}}\right)$，它在 $K$ 上是凸的，并意味着存在一个实现最佳收敛性能的最优 $K^{*}\in[1,M]$。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate our theoretical analysis under diverse settings.
sentences.zh: 大量实验在多种设置下验证了我们的理论分析。

title_en: Rethinking Depth Pruning for Vision Transformers: A Heterogeneity-Aware Perspective
title_zh: 重新思考视觉 Transformers 的深度剪枝：一种异构性感知的视角

sentences.en: While prior studies have successfully compressed vision Transformers (ViTs) through various pruning techniques, most have concentrated on width pruning to achieve significant reductions in model size.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的研究已通过多种剪枝技术成功压缩了视觉 Transformers（ViT），但大多数研究集中在宽度剪枝上，以实现模型规模的显著缩小。

sentences.en: Depth pruning, which removes entire layers from a ViT, is notoriously difficult for accuracy recovery despite its potential to deliver higher speedups, limiting the acceleration achieved by existing joint width-and-depth pruning methods.
sentences.zh: 深度剪枝会从 ViT 中移除整个层，尽管它有可能带来更高的加速，但准确率恢复却出奇地困难，这限制了现有联合宽度-深度剪枝方法所能实现的加速。

sentences.en: In this work, we reveal that the failure of existing depth pruning methods lies in their neglect of heterogeneity between different layers, and we introduce HetDPT, a heterogeneity-aware depth pruning method that avoids dimension mismatch.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们揭示现有深度剪枝方法失败的原因在于它们忽视了不同层之间的异构性，并提出 HetDPT，一种避免维度不匹配的异构性感知的深度剪枝方法。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on ImageNet-1K, CIFAR-100, COCO, and ADE20K validate our method: HetDPT achieves a 1.58$\times$ speedup for DeiT-B while maintaining accuracy and a 1.39$\times$ speedup for DeiT-S with nearly no accuracy degradation.
sentences.zh: 在 ImageNet-1K、CIFAR-100、COCO 与 ADE20K 上的全面实验验证了我们的方法：HetDPT 在保持准确率的同时，为 DeiT-B 实现了 1.58$\times$ 的加速，并在几乎无准确率退化的情况下为 DeiT-S 实现了 1.39$\times$ 的加速。

sentences.en: Furthermore, when combined with width pruning, HetDPT+ sets a new state-of-the-art record in extreme ViT pruning, enhancing the acceleration ratio from 4.24$\times$ to 5.19$\times$ for the Isomorphic-Pruning-2.6G configuration while maintaining near-lossless accuracy; our code is available at \url{https://github.com/Efficient-AI-for-All/HetDPT}.
sentences.zh: 此外，当与宽度剪枝结合时，HetDPT+ 在极端 ViT 剪枝中创下了新的最先进纪录，将 Isomorphic-Pruning-2.6G 配置的加速比从 4.24$\times$ 提升至 5.19$\times$，同时保持接近无损的准确率；我们的代码可在 \url{https://github.com/Efficient-AI-for-All/HetDPT} 获取。
