title_en: Rethinking Efficient Graph Coarsening via a Non-Selfishness Principle
title_zh: 通过非自利原则重新思考高效的图粗化

sentences.en: Graph coarsening is a graph dimensionality reduction technique that aims to construct a smaller and more tractable graph while preserving the essential structural and semantic properties of the original graph.
sentences.zh: 图粗化是一种图降维技术，旨在构造一个更小、更易处理的图，同时保留原始图的基本结构与语义属性。

sentences.en: However, most existing methods rely on pair-wise similarity matching, where each node independently searches for its best partner based on global information.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有方法依赖两两相似度匹配，其中每个节点基于全局信息独立寻找其最佳伙伴。

sentences.en: This selfishness matching paradigm incurs substantial computational and memory overhead.
sentences.zh: 这种自利匹配范式带来了巨大的计算与内存开销。

sentences.en: To address this problem, we shift to a non-selfishness principle that prioritizes the collective interference of neighborhood in coarsening, and propose an efficient method named NOPE, which achieves linear memory consumption and near-linear computational complexity in the number of nodes.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们转向一种非自利原则，在粗化中优先考虑邻域的集体影响，并提出一种高效方法 NOPE，它在节点数量上实现了线性内存消耗与近线性的计算复杂度。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we derive a faster variant NOPE*, which reduces O(\Delta\cdot d) interference evaluation to O(d) based on the local isotropy assumption, and consequently alleviates the computational bottleneck for high-degree nodes.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们推导出更快的变体 NOPE*，它基于局部各向同性假设，将 O(\Delta\cdot d) 的干扰评估减少到 O(d)，从而缓解了高度节点的计算瓶颈。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that NOPE* achieves $1.8–10\times$ speedup over NOPE and surpass almost all baselines with 1-3 orders of magnitude acceleration.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，NOPE* 相比 NOPE 实现了 $1.8–10\times$ 的加速，并以 1-3 个数量级的加速超越了几乎所有基线。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, learning on coarsened graphs yields comparable performance to original graphs, and can even show superior performance over LLM-based graph reasoning owing to compact graph information.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在粗化图上的学习取得了与原始图相当的性能，甚至凭借紧凑的图信息可以表现出优于基于 LLM 的图推理的性能。

sentences.en: The code can be available at https://github.com/dazonglian/NOPE-main.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/dazonglian/NOPE-main 获取。

title_en: Rethinking Evaluation Paradigms in IBP-based Certified Training
title_zh: 重新思考基于 IBP 的认证训练中的评估范式

sentences.en: Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on many supervised learning tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations.
sentences.zh: 深度神经网络在许多监督学习任务上取得了强劲的性能，但仍易受对抗性扰动的影响。

sentences.en: Neural network verification provides mathematically rigorous robustness guarantees, yet at substantial computational cost.
sentences.zh: 神经网络验证提供了数学上严谨的鲁棒性保证，但计算成本相当高。

sentences.en: To mitigate this, certified training techniques optimise for verifiable robustness during training, typically inducing a trade-off between natural and certified accuracy controlled by method-specific hyperparameters.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，认证训练技术在训练期间优化可验证的鲁棒性，通常会引入一个由特定方法的超参数控制的自然准确率与认证准确率之间的权衡。

sentences.en: Because these metrics are inherently conflicting, the common practice of reporting a single configuration is problematic: it can mislead conclusions about overall performance and prevents unbiased assessments of the state of the art. We address this by evaluating certified training methods via Pareto front comparisons over the natural--certified accuracy trade-off.
sentences.zh: 由于这些指标本质上是相互冲突的，常见的只报告单一配置的做法是有问题的：它可能误导关于整体性能的结论，并妨碍对最先进水平的无偏评估。我们通过在自然–认证准确率权衡上进行帕累托前沿比较来解决这一问题。

sentences.en: To enable fair, method-agnostic comparisons, we perform efficient automated multi-objective hyperparameter optimisation to identify a set of Pareto-optimal configurations for each method.
sentences.zh: 为实现公平、方法无关的比较，我们执行高效、自动化的多目标超参数优化，为每种方法识别出一组帕累托最优配置。

sentences.en: This approach often uncovers substantial undertuning in previously reported configurations, yielding superior performance and establishing a new state of the art. Leveraging these fronts, we present the first comprehensive multi-objective comparison of certified training approaches, showing that prior advancements are less pronounced than assumed and revealing previously unreported performance complementarities.
sentences.zh: 这一方法往往能揭示先前报告配置中存在的严重调优不足，带来更优越的性能，并树立新的最先进水平。利用这些前沿，我们呈现了第一个面向认证训练方法的全面多目标比较，表明先前的进展不如人们假设的那样显著，并揭示出此前未被报告的性能互补性。

title_en: Rethinking Feature Alignment in Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection: A Relational Fingerprint-based Approach
title_zh: 重新思考通用图异常检测中的特征对齐：一种基于关系指纹的方法

sentences.en: Extending traditional graph anomaly detection (GAD) from one-for-one to one-for-all paradigms, generalist GAD aims to learn a universal detector for identifying anomalies on unseen graphs without graph-specific retraining.
sentences.zh: 将传统图异常检测（GAD）从一对一范式扩展到一对多范式，通用 GAD 旨在学习一个通用检测器，以便在无需针对特定图重新训练的情况下识别未见图上的异常。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, existing approaches primarily focus on aligning heterogeneous features across different data domains via PCA-based projection, which harmonizes feature dimensions but neglects semantic alignment.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要通过基于 PCA 的投影来对齐不同数据域之间的异构特征，这种投影协调了特征维度，却忽视了语义对齐。

sentences.en: As a result, GAD models fail to acquire semantically transferable knowledge from source-domain pre-training, and even exhibit negative transfer on unseen graphs.
sentences.zh: 因此，GAD 模型无法从源域预训练中获得语义可迁移的知识，甚至在未见图上表现出负迁移。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose a Relational Fingerprint-based generalist GAD approach (REFI-GAD for short), aligning heterogeneous raw features with a universal and semantics-aware relational fingerprint (REFI) that encodes anomaly-indicative cues from both contextual and structural perspectives.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出一种基于关系指纹的通用 GAD 方法（简称为 REFI-GAD），用一个普适的、语义感知的关系指纹（REFI）来对齐异质的原始特征，该指纹从上下文与结构两个视角编码异常指示线索。

sentences.en: Building on REFI, we design a fingerprint-grounded generalist GAD model, which combines a transformer-based encoder to capture domain-invariant knowledge with an SNR-guided refinement module for domain-specific adaptation.
sentences.zh: 在 REFI 的基础上，我们设计了一个基于指纹的通用 GAD 模型，它将基于 transformer 的编码器（用于捕获域不变知识）与一个 SNR 引导的细化模块（用于域特定适应）相结合。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 14 datasets demonstrate that REFI-GAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 在 14 个数据集上的大量实验表明，REFI-GAD 显著优于最先进的方法。

title_en: Rethinking Federated Prompt Learning for Medical Images: From Textual Tuning to Visual Manifold Anchoring
title_zh: 重新思考医学图像的联邦提示学习：从文本调优到视觉流形锚定

sentences.en: Federated Prompt Learning (FPL) adapts Vision-Language Models to privacy-sensitive medical imaging, typically via a textual tuning paradigm that assumes the frozen visual encoder provides a discriminative feature geometry.
sentences.zh: 联邦提示学习（FPL）将视觉—语言模型适配到隐私敏感的医学影像上，通常采用文本调优范式，该范式假设冻结的视觉编码器提供了具有判别性的特征几何结构。

sentences.en: We argue this assumption breaks down in medical settings, leading to two geometric pathologies: (1) Intra-client: Medical Manifold Collapse, where high morphological similarity reduces the effective rank of visual features; and (2) Inter-client: Medical Topological Misalignment, where heterogeneous acquisition protocols induce inconsistent geometry across clients.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这一假设在医学场景中会失效，导致两种几何病理：（1）客户端内：医学流形坍缩，即高度的形态相似性降低了视觉特征的有效秩；以及（2）客户端间：医学拓扑错位，即不同的采集协议导致跨客户端不一致的几何结构。

sentences.en: To address these, we propose FedMAP, which shifts the paradigm to Visual Manifold Anchoring.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 FedMAP，它将范式转向视觉流形锚定。

sentences.en: FedMAP utilizes an LLM-derived codebook as a client-invariant synchronization signal to restructure the visual space, via Manifold Semantic Anchoring (MSA) and Topology Structural Alignment (TSA) to enforce consistent inter-class relations.
sentences.zh: FedMAP 利用一个由 LLM 导出的码本作为客户端不变的同步信号，通过流形语义锚定（MSA）与拓扑结构对齐（TSA）来重构视觉空间，以强制一致的类间关系。

sentences.en: Experiments on FedISIC, FedCamelyon17, and a private ultrasound dataset show that FedMAP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, especially in high-noise regimes where manifold collapse is most severe.
sentences.zh: 在 FedISIC、FedCamelyon17 与一个私有超声数据集上的实验表明，FedMAP 一致地优于最先进的方法，尤其是在流形坍缩最严重的高噪声场景中。

title_en: Rethinking Forgery Attacks on Semantic Watermarks in Black-Box Settings: A Geometric Distortion Perspective
title_zh: 重新思考黑盒场景中针对语义水印的伪造攻击：一种几何失真视角

sentences.en: Recent studies have shown that semantic watermarks, which embed information into the initial noise of latent diffusion models (LDMs), are vulnerable to black-box forgery attacks.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，语义水印将信息嵌入到潜在扩散模型（LDM）的初始噪声中，容易受到黑盒伪造攻击。

sentences.en: However, existing methods primarily rely on empirical evidence and lack a rigorous theoretical understanding of the conditions under which such attacks succeed or fail.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要依赖实证证据，缺乏对这些攻击在何种条件下成功或失败的严谨理论理解。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we rethink the nature of such attacks through the lens of rate-distortion in the latent space.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们通过潜在空间中的率失真视角重新思考此类攻击的性质。

sentences.en: Our analysis identifies an irreducible distortion floor due to structural mismatches between proxy and target models, which fundamentally limits the fidelity of forged watermarks.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析识别出一个由代理模型与目标模型之间的结构失配导致的不可约失真下限，它从根本上限制了伪造水印的保真度。

sentences.en: We further characterize this distortion as structured geometric deviations on the latent manifold, in the form of global drift and local deformation rather than stochastic noise.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将该失真刻画为潜在流形上结构化的几何偏差，表现为全局漂移与局部形变，而非随机噪声。

sentences.en: Leveraging these insights, we propose a scheme-agnostic detection method that distinguishes forged samples before watermark verification.
sentences.zh: 利用这些洞见，我们提出一种与方案无关的检测方法，它在水印验证之前区分伪造样本。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method across diverse black-box scenarios, while preserving robustness to common distortions.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明了我们的方法在多种黑盒场景下的有效性，同时保持对常见失真的鲁棒性。

title_en: Rethinking Gating Mechanism in Sparse MoE: Handling Arbitrary Modality Inputs with Confidence-Guided Gate
title_zh: 重新思考稀疏 MoE 中的门控机制：用置信度引导的门控处理任意模态输入

sentences.en: Effectively managing missing modalities is a fundamental challenge in real-world multimodal learning scenarios, where data incompleteness often results from systematic collection errors or sensor failures.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界的多模态学习场景中，有效管理缺失模态是一个基本挑战，其中数据不完整往往源于系统性的采集错误或传感器故障。

sentences.en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) architectures have the potential to naturally handle multimodal data, with individual experts specializing in different modalities.
sentences.zh: 稀疏混合专家（SMoE）架构具有自然地处理多模态数据的潜力，其中各个专家专门处理不同模态。

sentences.en: However, existing SMoE approach often lacks proper ability to handle missing modality, leading to performance degradation and poor generalization in real-world applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 SMoE 方法往往缺乏处理缺失模态的适当能力，导致在真实应用中出现性能退化与较差的泛化。

sentences.en: We propose ConfSMoE to introduce a two-stage imputation module to handle the missing modality problem for the SMoE architecture by taking the opinion of experts and reveal the insight of expert collapse from theoretical analysis with strong empirical evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 ConfSMoE，引入一个两阶段插补模块，通过采纳专家的意见来处理 SMoE 架构中的缺失模态问题，并从理论分析与强有力的实证证据中揭示专家坍缩的洞见。

sentences.en: Inspired by our theoretical analysis, ConfSMoE propose a novel expert gating mechanism by detaching the softmax routing score to task confidence score w.r.t ground truth signal.
sentences.zh: 受我们理论分析的启发，ConfSMoE 提出一种新颖的专家门控机制，它将软最大值路由分数解耦为相对真值信号的任务置信度分数。

sentences.en: This naturally relieves expert collapse without introducing additional load balance loss function.
sentences.zh: 这自然地缓解了专家坍缩，而无需引入额外的负载均衡损失函数。

sentences.en: We show that the insights of expert collapse aligns with other gating mechanism such as Gaussian and Laplacian gate.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，专家坍缩的洞见与其他门控机制（如高斯门与拉普拉斯门）是一致的。

sentences.en: The proposed method is evaluated on four different real world dataset with three distinct experiment settings to conduct comprehensive analysis of ConfSMoE on resistance to missing modality and the impacts of proposed gating mechanism.
sentences.zh: 所提出的方法在四个不同的真实世界数据集与三种不同的实验设置上进行评估，以对 ConfSMoE 在缺失模态抵抗性以及所提出门控机制的影响进行综合分析。

title_en: Rethinking Generative Image Pretraining: How Far Are We From Scaling Up Next-Pixel Prediction?
title_zh: 重新思考生成式图像预训练：距离扩展下一像素预测还有多远？

sentences.en: This paper investigates the scaling properties of autoregressive next-pixel prediction, a simple, end-to-end yet under-explored framework for unified vision models.
sentences.zh: 本文研究自回归下一像素预测的缩放特性，这是一个简单、端到端且尚未充分探索的统一视觉模型框架。

sentences.en: Starting with images at resolutions of 32$\times$ 32, we train a family of Transformers using IsoFLOP profiles across compute budgets up to 7e19 FLOPs and evaluate three distinct target metrics: next-pixel prediction objective, ImageNet classification accuracy, and generation-based completion where top half of the image serves as a spatial prompt.
sentences.zh: 从分辨率为 32$\times$32 的图像开始，我们使用 IsoFLOP 配置在高达 7e19 FLOPs 的计算预算上训练一系列 Transformers，并评估三个不同的目标指标：下一像素预测目标、ImageNet 分类准确率，以及基于生成的补全（其中图像上半部分作为空间提示）。

sentences.en: First, optimal scaling strategy is critically task-dependent.
sentences.zh: 首先，最优缩放策略严重依赖于任务。

sentences.en: At a fixed resolution of 32 $\times$ 32 alone,  the optimal scaling properties for image classification and image generation diverge, where generation optimal setup requires the data size grow three to five times faster than for the classification optimal setup.
sentences.zh: 仅就固定分辨率 32 $\times$32 而言，图像分类与图像生成的最优缩放特性就出现分歧，其中生成最优配置要求数据规模以比分类最优配置快三到五倍的速度增长。

sentences.en: Second, as image resolution increases, the optimal scaling strategy indicates that the model size must grow much faster than data size.
sentences.zh: 其次，随着图像分辨率的提高，最优缩放策略表明模型规模必须比数据规模增长得快得多。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, by projecting our findings, we discover that the primary bottleneck is compute rather than the amount of training data.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，通过推演我们的发现，我们揭示出主要瓶颈是计算而非训练数据量。

sentences.en: As compute continues to grow four to five times annually, we forecast the feasibility of pixel-by-pixel modeling of images within the next five years.
sentences.zh: 随着计算量继续以每年四到五倍的速度增长，我们预测在未来五年内实现图像的逐像素建模是可行的。

title_en: Rethinking Genomic Modeling Through Optical Character Recognition
title_zh: 通过光学字符识别重新思考基因组建模

sentences.en: Recent genomic foundation models largely adopt large language model architectures that treat DNA as a one-dimensional token sequence.
sentences.zh: 近期的基因组基础模型大多采用大语言模型架构，将 DNA 视为一维词元序列。

sentences.en: However, exhaustive sequential reading is structurally misaligned with sparse and discontinuous genomic semantics, leading to wasted computation on low-information background and preventing understanding-driven compression for long contexts.
sentences.zh: 然而，穷举式的顺序阅读与稀疏、非连续的基因组语义在结构上错位，导致在低信息背景上的计算浪费，并妨碍了面向长上下文的、由理解驱动的压缩。

sentences.en: Here, we present OpticalDNA, a vision-based framework that reframes genomic modeling as Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-style document understanding.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们提出 OpticalDNA，一个基于视觉的框架，它将基因组建模重构为光学字符识别（OCR）风格的文档理解。

sentences.en: OpticalDNA renders DNA into structured visual layouts and trains an OCR-capable vision--language model with a \emph{visual DNA encoder} and a \emph{document decoder}, where the encoder produces compact, reconstructible visual tokens for high-fidelity compression.
sentences.zh: OpticalDNA 将 DNA 渲染为结构化的视觉布局，并训练一个具备 OCR 能力的视觉—语言模型，该模型包含一个 \emph{visual DNA encoder}（视觉 DNA 编码器）与一个 \emph{document decoder}（文档解码器），其中编码器产生紧凑、可重建的视觉词元以实现高保真压缩。

sentences.en: Building on this representation, OpticalDNA defines prompt-conditioned objectives over core genomic primitives—reading, region grounding, subsequence retrieval, and masked span completion—thereby learning layout-aware DNA representations that retain fine-grained genomic information under a reduced effective token budget.
sentences.zh: 在此表示的基础上，OpticalDNA 在核心基因组基元上定义提示条件化的目标——阅读、区域定位、子序列检索与掩码跨度补全——从而学习布局感知的 DNA 表示，在缩减的有效词元预算下保留细粒度的基因组信息。

sentences.en: Across diverse genomic benchmarks, OpticalDNA consistently outperforms recent baselines; on sequences up to 450k bases, it achieves the best overall performance with nearly $20\times$ fewer effective tokens, and surpasses models with up to $985\times$ more activated parameters while tuning only 256k \emph{trainable} parameters.
sentences.zh: 在多样的基因组基准上，OpticalDNA 一致地优于近期基线；在长达 450k 碱基的序列上，它以近乎 $20\times$ 更少的有效词元取得最佳整体性能，并在仅微调 256k 个 \emph{trainable}（可训练）参数的情况下，超越了激活参数多达 $985\times$ 的模型。

title_en: Rethinking GNNs and Missing Features: Challenges, Evaluation and a Robust Solution
title_zh: 重新思考 GNN 与缺失特征：挑战、评估与一个稳健的解决方案

sentences.en: Handling missing node features is a key challenge for deploying Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) in real-world domains such as healthcare and sensor networks.
sentences.zh: 处理缺失的节点特征是图神经网络（GNN）在医疗与传感器网络等真实领域部署的一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: Existing studies mostly address relatively benign scenarios, namely benchmark datasets with (a) high-dimensional but sparse node features and (b) incomplete data generated under Missing Completely At Random (MCAR) mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 现有研究大多处理相对良性的场景，即具有（a）高维但稀疏的节点特征与（b）在完全随机缺失（MCAR）机制下产生的不完整数据的基准数据集。

sentences.en: For (a), we theoretically prove that high sparsity substantially limits the information loss caused by missingness, making all models appear robust and preventing a meaningful comparison of their performance.
sentences.zh: 对于（a），我们在理论上证明，高稀疏性实质性地限制了缺失所造成的信息损失，使所有模型看起来都很鲁棒，从而妨碍了对它们性能的有意义比较。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we introduce one synthetic and three real-world datasets with dense, semantically meaningful features.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们引入一个合成与三个带有稠密、语义意义丰富特征的真实世界数据集。

sentences.en: For (b), we move beyond MCAR and design evaluation protocols with more realistic missingness mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 对于（b），我们超越 MCAR，设计具有更真实缺失机制的评估协议。

sentences.en: Moreover, we provide a theoretical background to state explicit assumptions on the missingness process and analyze their implications for different methods.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提供理论背景，以对缺失过程作出显式假设，并分析它们对不同方法的影响。

sentences.en: Building on this analysis, we show that a simple baseline adapted to the graph domain is competitive with respect to specialized architectures across diverse datasets and missingness regimes.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们表明，一个适配到图领域的简单基线，在多样的数据集与缺失机制上与专门架构具有竞争力。

title_en: Rethinking Graph Transformers as Graph Signal Denoisers: The Role of Block-Diagonal Priors
title_zh: 将图 Transformers 重新理解为图信号去噪器：块对角先验的作用

sentences.en: By synergizing graph topology with the global expressive power of attention, Graph Transformers (GTs) have emerged as a powerful architecture for node classification.
sentences.zh: 通过将图拓扑与注意力的全局表达能力协同结合，图 Transformers（GT）已成为节点分类的一种强大架构。

sentences.en: Existing GTs mainly focus on diverse topology injection paradigms, which fundamentally construct different propagation operators.
sentences.zh: 现有的 GT 主要关注多样的拓扑注入范式，它们从根本上构造不同的传播算子。

sentences.en: However, a unified theoretical understanding of what constitutes a desirable propagation operator remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，关于什么样的传播算子才是理想的，目前仍缺乏统一的理论理解。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, this paper rethinks GTs from a graph signal denoising perspective, revealing that a block-diagonal structure is a desirable structural prior for graph denoising.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，本文从图信号去噪的视角重新思考 GT，揭示块对角结构是图去噪中一种理想的结构先验。

sentences.en: To efficiently instantiate this prior, this paper introduces BDFormer, which imposes spectral block regularization on the affinity of a compact set of latent anchors.
sentences.zh: 为高效实例化这一先验，本文引入 BDFormer，它对紧凑潜在锚点集的亲和矩阵施加谱块正则化。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by introducing hard assignments between nodes and anchors, BDFormer establishes sparse, structured propagation that suppresses noisy cross-class propagation in linear time.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过引入节点与锚点之间的硬分配，BDFormer 建立了稀疏、结构化的传播，在线性时间内抑制了有噪声的跨类传播。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the learned global affinity guides the pruning of inter-class edges in the graph topology, enabling both global and local propagation to jointly adhere to the target block-diagonal structure.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，所学习的全局亲和性指导对图拓扑中类间边的剪枝，使全局与局部传播都能共同遵循目标块对角结构。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority and scalability of BDFormer.
sentences.zh: 在基准数据集上的大量实验证明了 BDFormer 的优越性与可扩展性。

title_en: Rethinking Human Intent-to-CAD: Parametric CAD Model Generation via Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 重新思考从人类意图到 CAD：通过协作式多任务对齐与空间感知强化学习生成参数化 CAD 模型

sentences.en: Parametric Computer-Aided-Design (CAD) modeling from human intent remains challenging, particularly during the conceptual design stage, where design goals are expressed through incomplete and unstructured modalities (e.g., hand-drawn sketches and textual descriptions).
sentences.zh: 从人类意图进行参数化计算机辅助设计（CAD）建模仍具挑战性，尤其是在概念设计阶段，此时设计目标通过不完整且非结构化的模态（例如手绘草图与文本描述）来表达。

sentences.en: In this work, we rethink the human intent-to-CAD pipeline and propose a unified method that directly maps multi-level human intents to executable codes, without assuming the prior existence of target CAD models.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们重新思考从人类意图到 CAD 的流水线，并提出一个统一的方法，将多层级的人类意图直接映射为可执行的代码，而无需假定目标 CAD 模型的预先存在。

sentences.en: To support our study, we construct HiCAD, the first large-scale dataset aligning hand-drawn sketches, textual descriptions, and parametric CAD codes.
sentences.zh: 为支撑我们的研究，我们构建 HiCAD，第一个将手绘草图、文本描述与参数化 CAD 代码对齐的大规模数据集。

sentences.en: Based on this, we introduce HiCAD, a two-stage framework comprising Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment to bridge the representational gap between heterogeneous inputs, and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning to enforce geometric and topological consistency.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们引入 HiCAD，一个两阶段框架，包括协作式多任务对齐（用于弥合异构输入之间的表示差距）与空间感知强化学习（用于强制几何与拓扑一致性）。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines across multiple tasks, validating its effectiveness and robustness in transforming heterogeneous human intents into high-fidelity parametric CAD models.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在多个任务上显著优于现有基线，验证了其在将异构人类意图转化为高保真参数化 CAD 模型方面的有效性与鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Our project page: https://zqwlearning.github.io/HiCAD.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目页面：https://zqwlearning.github.io/HiCAD。

title_en: Rethinking Instruction Drift as a Sampling Error: SNR-Aware Power Distributions for Long-Horizon Robotic Planning
title_zh: 将指令漂移重新思考为采样误差：面向长视界机器人规划的 SNR 感知幂分布

sentences.en: Despite rapid progress in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic control, instruction drift remains a persistent failure mode in long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 尽管视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型在机器人控制方面取得了快速进展，指令漂移仍是长视界任务中一种持续存在的失效模式。

sentences.en: This paper reconceptualizes this phenomenon, positing that instruction drift is fundamentally a systematic sampling error: local greedy sampling is prone to collapsing into “Negative Pivotal Windows”—irreversible local optima with high local probability that sever global success pathways.
sentences.zh: 本文对这种现象进行重新概念化，指出指令漂移从根本上是一种系统性采样误差：局部贪婪采样容易坍缩进“负枢轴窗口”（Negative Pivotal Windows）——具有高局部概率、切断全局成功路径的不可逆局部最优。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Context-Aware Power Sampling (CAPS), a training-free inference-time computation framework.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出上下文感知的幂采样（Context-Aware Power Sampling，CAPS），一个免训练的推理时计算框架。

sentences.en: CAPS leverages power distributions to sharpen global trajectory probabilities, enabling lookahead search over the model's conditional generative trajectory distribution.
sentences.zh: CAPS 利用幂分布来锐化全局轨迹概率，从而能够在模型的条件生成式轨迹分布上进行前瞻搜索。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce a metacognitive control mechanism based on Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR).
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入一种基于信噪比（SNR）的元认知控制机制。

sentences.en: This mechanism triggers adaptive MCMC search solely when drift risk is detected, enabling a dynamic transition from “intuitive fast thinking” to “rational slow search.”
sentences.zh: 该机制仅在检测到漂移风险时触发自适应 MCMC 搜索，实现从“直觉快速思维”到“理性缓慢搜索”的动态转换。

sentences.en: Experiments on RoboTwin, Simpler-WindowX, and Libero-long benchmarks show that CAPS achieves substantial improvements over strong baselines, including OpenVLA and TACO, without parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 在 RoboTwin、Simpler-WindowX 与 Libero-long 基准上的实验表明，CAPS 在无需参数更新的情况下，相较包括 OpenVLA 与 TACO 在内的强基线取得了显著改进。

sentences.en: These results support the effectiveness of adaptive inference-time computation for improving long-horizon robustness in embodied control.
sentences.zh: 这些结果支持自适应推理时计算对改善具身控制中长视界鲁棒性的有效性。

title_en: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective
title_zh: 通过统一的信息论目标重新思考 KV 缓存驱逐

sentences.en: Key–value (KV) caching is essential for large language model inference, yet its memory overhead poses a critical bottleneck for long-context generation.
sentences.zh: 键值（KV）缓存对大语言模型推理至关重要，但其内存开销构成了长上下文生成的关键瓶颈。

sentences.en: Existing eviction policies predominantly rely on empirical heuristics, lacking a rigorous theoretical foundation.
sentences.zh: 现有的驱逐策略主要依赖经验启发式，缺乏严谨的理论基础。

sentences.en: This work rethinks KV cache eviction through the lens of the Information Bottleneck principle.
sentences.zh: 本工作通过信息瓶颈原则的视角重新思考 KV 缓存驱逐。

sentences.en: Under a linear–Gaussian surrogate of attention, we derive a closed-form mutual information objective that characterizes the effective information capacity of a retained KV cache subset.
sentences.zh: 在注意力的线性–高斯代理下，我们推导出一个闭式互信息目标，它刻画了所保留的 KV 缓存子集的有效信息容量。

sentences.en: This formulation reveals that a wide range of existing eviction strategies can be interpreted as different approximations of the same capacity-maximization principle.
sentences.zh: 这一形式揭示，现有的广泛驱逐策略可以被解读为同一容量最大化原则的不同近似。

sentences.en: Guided by this insight, we introduce CapKV, a capacity-aware eviction method that directly targets information preservation via a log-determinant approximation using statistical leverage scores.
sentences.zh: 在这一洞见的指导下，我们引入 CapKV，一种容量感知的驱逐方法，它通过使用统计杠杆分数的对数行列式近似，直接面向信息保持。

sentences.en: This approach replaces heuristic selection with a theoretically grounded mechanism that preserves the maximum predictive signal.
sentences.zh: 这一方法用有理论依据的机制取代启发式选择，保留最大的预测信号。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple models and long-context benchmarks show that CapKV consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving a better trade-off between memory efficiency and generational fidelity.
sentences.zh: 在多种模型与长上下文基准上的大量实验表明，CapKV 一致地优于先前方法，在内存效率与生成保真度之间取得了更好的权衡。

title_en: Rethinking LLM Ensembling from the Perspective of Mixture Models
title_zh: 从混合模型的视角重新思考 LLM 集成

sentences.en: Model ensembling is a well-established technique for improving the performance of machine learning models.
sentences.zh: 模型集成是一种成熟的技术，用于提升机器学习模型的性能。

sentences.en: Conventionally, this involves averaging the output distributions of multiple models and selecting the most probable label.
sentences.zh: 传统上，这涉及对多个模型的输出分布进行平均，并选择最可能的标签。

sentences.en: This idea has been naturally extended to large language models (LLMs), yielding improved performance but incurring substantial computational cost.
sentences.zh: 这一思想已被自然地扩展到大型语言模型（LLM），取得了改进的性能，但带来了可观的计算成本。

sentences.en: This inefficiency stems from directly applying conventional ensemble implementation to LLMs, which require a separate forward pass for each model to explicitly compute the ensemble distribution.
sentences.zh: 这种低效源于将传统的集成实现直接应用于 LLM，而 LLM 需要为每个模型分别进行一次前向传播，以显式计算集成分布。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose the Mixture-model-like Ensemble (ME).
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出类混合模型集成（Mixture-model-like Ensemble，ME）。

sentences.en: By reinterpreting the ensemble as a mixture model, ME stochastically selects a single model at each step to generate the next token, thereby avoiding the need to explicitly compute the full ensemble distribution.
sentences.zh: 通过将集成重新解读为混合模型，ME 在每一步随机选择单个模型来生成下一个词元，从而避免显式计算完整的集成分布。

sentences.en: ME is mathematically equivalent to sampling from the ensemble distribution, but requires invoking only one model, making it 1.78×-2.68× faster than conventional ensemble.
sentences.zh: ME 在数学上等价于从集成分布中采样，但只需调用一个模型，使其比传统集成快 1.78×-2.68×。

sentences.en: Furthermore, this perspective connects LLM ensembling and token-level routing methods, suggesting that LLM ensembling is a special case of routing methods.
sentences.zh: 此外，这一视角将 LLM 集成与词元级路由方法联系起来，表明 LLM 集成是路由方法的一个特例。

sentences.en: Our findings open new avenues for efficient LLM ensembling and motivate further exploration of token-level routing strategies for LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现为高效的 LLM 集成开辟了新的途径，并激励对面向 LLM 的词元级路由策略进行进一步探索。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Mixture-model-like-Ensemble/.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Mixture-model-like-Ensemble/ 获取。

title_en: Rethinking Loss Reweighting for Imbalance Learning as an Inverse Problem: A Neural Collapse Point of View
title_zh: 将损失重加权重新思考为逆问题：一种神经坍缩视角

sentences.en: Loss reweighting is a widely used strategy for long-tailed classification, but existing reweighting strategies often rely on heuristics and rarely define a well-specified target.
sentences.zh: 损失重加权是长尾分类中一种被广泛使用的策略，但现有的重加权策略常常依赖启发式方法，且很少定义明确的目标。

sentences.en: Inspired by Neural Collapse (NC), the ideal simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) terminal geometry suggests equal per-class average loss as a reasonable target for reweighting.
sentences.zh: 受神经坍缩（NC）的启发，理想的单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）终端几何结构表明，各类平均损失相等是一个合理的重加权目标。

sentences.en: Based on the ideal equal loss objective, we consider loss reweighting as an inverse problem and propose an inverse-view reweighting strategy that infers class weights dynamically to match this ideal objective.
sentences.zh: 基于理想的等损失目标，我们将损失重加权视为一个逆问题，并提出一种逆视角的重加权策略，它动态推断类权重以匹配这一理想目标。

sentences.en: Empirically, NC metrics suggest our method can effectively reduce the loss imbalance coefficient and achieve closer alignment with NC geometry while consistently outperforming strong long-tailed baselines on different datasets.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，NC 指标表明我们的方法能够有效降低损失失衡系数，实现与 NC 几何结构更接近的对齐，同时在多个数据集上一致地超越强长尾基线。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tongzixin716716/Inverse-Loss-Reweighting.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在：https://github.com/tongzixin716716/Inverse-Loss-Reweighting 公开获取。

title_en: Rethinking Low-Confidence Pseudo Labels: Influence-Aware Semi-Supervised Fine-Tuning for Hyperspectral Change Detection
title_zh: 重新思考低置信度伪标签：面向高光谱变化检测的影响感知半监督微调

sentences.en: Hyperspectral image change detection (HSI-CD) suffers from severe annotation scarcity and complex change patterns, which fundamentally limit the effectiveness of directly fine-tuning pre-trained foundation models.
sentences.zh: 高光谱图像变化检测（HSI-CD）饱受严重的标注稀缺与复杂变化模式之苦，这从根本上限制了直接微调预训练基础模型的效果。

sentences.en: Although semi-supervised learning provides a promising direction, existing approaches mainly rely on confidence-based pseudo-label selection, leading to limited data diversity or severe error propagation.
sentences.zh: 虽然半监督学习提供了一个有前途的方向，但现有方法主要依赖基于置信度的伪标签选择，导致数据多样性有限或严重的错误传播。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Influence-Aware Semi-supervised Fine-tuning (IA-SFT), a novel framework that evaluates the influence of pseudo-labels on model decision behavior to identify truly valuable supervision signals.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出影响感知的半监督微调（Influence-Aware Semi-supervised Fine-tuning，IA-SFT），一个评估伪标签对模型决策行为影响以识别真正有价值的监督信号的新框架。

sentences.en: Instead of confidence-based selection, IA-SFT evaluates each low-confidence pseudo-label by measuring its impact on labeled data, enabling reliable filtering of high-value pseudo-labels with minimal noise.
sentences.zh: 与基于置信度的选择不同，IA-SFT 通过衡量每个低置信度伪标签对标注数据的影响来评估它，从而能够以最小的噪声可靠地过滤出高价值的伪标签。

sentences.en: To further adapt foundation models to HSI-CD, we design an Adaptive Fusion Change Decoder (AFCD) that jointly models global semantic consistency and local change details.
sentences.zh: 为进一步将基础模型适配到 HSI-CD，我们设计了一个自适应融合变化解码器（AFCD），它联合建模全局语义一致性与局部变化细节。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that IA-SFT consistently improves pseudo-label quality and detection performance, achieving superior accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods.
sentences.zh: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，IA-SFT 持续提升伪标签质量与检测性能，相比最先进的方法取得了更优越的准确率。

sentences.en: Additional analyses validate the transferability of IA-SFT when integrated into different frameworks in a plug-and-play manner.
sentences.zh: 进一步的分析验证了 IA-SFT 以即插即用的方式集成到不同框架中时的可迁移性。

sentences.en: Code will be released.
sentences.zh: 代码将发布。

title_en: Rethinking Memory in Continual Learning: Beyond a Monolithic Store of the Past
title_zh: 重新思考持续学习中的记忆：超越对过去的单一存储

sentences.en: Memory is a critical component in replay-based continual learning (CL).
sentences.zh: 记忆是基于回放的持续学习（CL）中的一个关键组成部分。

sentences.en: Prior research has largely treated CL memory as a monolithic store of past data, focusing on how to select and store representative past examples.
sentences.zh: 先前的研究在很大程度上将 CL 记忆视为过去数据的单一存储，重点关注如何选择与存储具有代表性的过去样本。

sentences.en: However, this perspective overlooks the higher-level memory architecture that governs the interaction between old and new data.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种视角忽视了支配新旧数据交互的更高层记忆架构。

sentences.en: In this work, we identify and characterize a dual-memory system that is inherently present in both online and offline CL settings.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们识别并刻画了一个在在线与离线 CL 设置中都固有存在的双记忆系统。

sentences.en: This system comprises: a short-term memory, which temporarily buffers recent data for immediate model updates, and a long-term memory, which maintains a carefully curated subset of past experiences for future replay and consolidation.
sentences.zh: 该系统包含：一个短期记忆，它临时缓冲近期数据以进行即时模型更新；以及一个长期记忆，它维护一个精心整理的过去经验子集，用于未来的回放与巩固。

sentences.en: We propose  \textit{memory capacity ratio} (MCR), the ratio between short-term memory and long-term memory capacities, to characterize online and offline CL.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 \textit{memory capacity ratio}（MCR，记忆容量比），即短期记忆与长期记忆容量之比，用以刻画在线与离线 CL。

sentences.en: Based on this framework, we systematically investigate how MCR influences generalization, stability, and plasticity.
sentences.zh: 在该框架的基础上，我们系统地研究了 MCR 如何影响泛化、稳定性与可塑性。

sentences.en: Across diverse CL settings—class-incremental, task-incremental, and domain-incremental—and multiple data modalities (e.g., image and text classification), we observe that a smaller MCR, characteristic of \textit{online CL}, can yield comparable or even superior performance relative to a larger one, characteristic of \textit{offline CL}, when both are evaluated under equivalent computational and data storage budgets.
sentences.zh: 在多样的 CL 设置（类增量、任务增量与域增量）以及多种数据模态（例如图像与文本分类）中，我们观察到，当在等效的计算与数据存储预算下评估时，较小的 MCR（\textit{online CL} 的特征）可以取得与较大的 MCR（\textit{offline CL} 的特征）相当甚至更优的性能。

sentences.en: This advantage holds consistently across several state-of-the-art replay strategies, such as ER, DER, and SCR.
sentences.zh: 这一优势在多种最先进的回放策略（如 ER、DER 与 SCR）上始终成立。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis further reveals that a reduced MCR yields a better trade-off between stability and plasticity by lowering a bound on generalization error when learning from non-stationary data streams with limited memory.
sentences.zh: 理论分析进一步揭示，当从样本量有限、非平稳的数据流中学习时，减小的 MCR 通过降低泛化误差的界，在稳定性与可塑性之间实现了更好的权衡。

sentences.en: These findings offer new insights into the role of memory allocation in continual learning and underscore the underexplored potential of online CL approaches.
sentences.zh: 这些发现为持续学习中记忆分配的作用提供了新的洞见，并凸显了在线 CL 方法未被充分探索的潜力。

title_en: Rethinking Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting Evaluation
title_zh: 重新思考多模态时间序列预测评估

sentences.en: We introduce a new context-enriched, multimodal time series forecasting benchmark TimesX. TimesX contains a wide selection of high-quality real-world time series with diverse domains and textual contexts obtained from an automated data generation pipeline, which helps address three main issues of existing multimodal forecasting benchmarks: (1) poor generalization due to the small scale and synthetic nature of benchmark data, (2) very limited types of textual contexts in the benchmarks, and (3) an inability to mitigate data leakage in evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个新的、上下文丰富的多模态时间序列预测基准 TimesX。TimesX 包含了来自自动化数据生成流水线获得的一系列高质量真实世界时间序列，具有多样的领域与文本上下文，这有助于解决现有多模态预测基准的三个主要问题：（1）由于基准数据规模小且为合成性质导致的泛化差，（2）基准中文本上下文类型非常有限，以及（3）无法在评估中缓解数据泄漏。

sentences.en: We conduct a thorough empirical study of zero-shot multimodal forecasting approaches on TimesX. Our results suggest that many approaches that perform well on existing benchmarks may fail on TimesX.
sentences.zh: 我们在 TimesX 上对零样本多模态预测方法进行了全面的实证研究。我们的结果表明，许多在现有基准上表现良好的方法可能在 TimesX 上失败。

sentences.en: In contrast, simple ensemble methods that leverage rich textual context accompanying time-series can outperform strong baselines on the TimesX benchmark.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，利用伴随时间序列的丰富文本上下文的简单集成方法，可以在 TimesX 基准上超越强基线。

title_en: Rethinking Neural Network Learning Rates: A Stackelberg Perspective
title_zh: 重新思考神经网络学习率：一种 Stackelberg 视角

sentences.en: Neural networks are typically trained with a single learning rate across all layers.
sentences.zh: 神经网络通常在所有层上使用单一学习率进行训练。

sentences.en: While recent empirical evidence suggests that assigning layer-specific learning rates can accelerate training, a principled understanding of the conditions and mechanisms under which non-uniform learning rates are beneficial remains limited.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期实证证据表明，为各层分配专属学习率可以加速训练，但对于非均匀学习率在何种条件与机制下有益的规范性理解仍然有限。

sentences.en: In this work, we investigate non-uniform learning rates through the lens of Stackelberg optimization.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过 Stackelberg 优化的视角研究非均匀学习率。

sentences.en: Specifically, we demonstrate that training neural networks with a smaller learning rate for the body layers and a larger learning rate for the final layer can be interpreted as a two-time-scale alternating gradient descent algorithm applied to a Stackelberg reformulation of the original objective.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们证明，用较小学习率训练主体层、用较大学习率训练末层，可以解释为对原始目标的 Stackelberg 重构施加的一种两时间尺度交替梯度下降算法。

sentences.en: We establish finite-time convergence guarantees for the algorithm under broad conditions that accommodate constraint sets and non-smooth activation functions.
sentences.zh: 我们在能够容纳约束集与非光滑激活函数的广泛条件下，为该算法建立了有限时间收敛保证。

sentences.en: Beyond convergence, we identify two mechanisms by which non-uniform learning rates can outperform uniform learning rates: (i) we show that certain problem instances induce a Stackelberg objective with stronger optimization structure than the original objective, yielding faster convergence to globally optimal solutions, (ii) our numerical analysis reveals that the Stackelberg objective can exhibit substantially sharper local curvature, especially in early training, which leads to more informative gradients and learning acceleration.
sentences.zh: 超越收敛性，我们识别出非均匀学习率能够优于均匀学习率的两种机制：（i）我们表明，某些问题实例会引入一个比原始目标具有更强优化结构的 Stackelberg 目标，从而更快收敛到全局最优解；（ii）我们的数值分析揭示，Stackelberg 目标可以表现出明显更尖锐的局部曲率，尤其是在训练早期，这带来更具信息量的梯度与学习加速。

sentences.en: Experiments in supervised learning and reinforcement learning support our findings.
sentences.zh: 监督学习与强化学习中的实验支持了我们的发现。

title_en: Rethinking Parameter Sharing as Graph Coloring for Structured Compression
title_zh: 重新思考参数共享：用图着色实现结构化压缩

sentences.en: Parameter sharing is a key model compression technique, yet existing methods overlook the geometric properties of the loss landscape, often causing severe accuracy degradation under high compression ratios.
sentences.zh: 参数共享是一种关键的模型压缩技术，但现有方法忽视了损失景观的几何特性，往往在高压缩率下造成严重的准确率退化。

sentences.en: Inspired by second-order optimization, we propose Curvature-aware Graph Coloring (CGC), a cross-layer parameter sharing framework that treats each network layer as a graph node, with each node assigned to a shared low-rank basis.
sentences.zh: 受二阶优化启发，我们提出曲率感知的图着色（Curvature-aware Graph Coloring，CGC），一个跨层参数共享框架，它将每个网络层视为一个图节点，并为每个节点分配一个共享的低秩基。

sentences.en: CGC leverages Hessian eigenspace information to group layers with similar curvature profiles, aligning the perturbations introduced by parameter sharing with the low-curvature (flat) directions of the loss ellipsoid.
sentences.zh: CGC 利用 Hessian 特征空间信息，将具有相似曲率轮廓的层分组，使参数共享引入的扰动与损失椭球的低曲率（平坦）方向对齐。

sentences.en: This effectively mitigates performance loss while enabling flexible, global cross-layer sharing.
sentences.zh: 这有效缓解了性能损失，同时实现了灵活的、全局的跨层共享。

sentences.en: Experiments on LLaMA-7B and Swin Transformer show that CGC achieves 28\%–50\% parameter compression with Top-1 accuracy loss no more than 0.01\% on Swin—or even accuracy gains on LLaMA—while delivering over 60\% higher inference throughput, significantly outperforming SVD-based and heuristic-based methods.
sentences.zh: 在 LLaMA-7B 与 Swin Transformer 上的实验表明，CGC 实现了 28\%-50\% 的参数压缩，Swin 上的 Top-1 准确率损失不超过 0.01\%（LLaMA 上甚至获得准确率提升），同时提供了超过 60% 的推理吞吐量提升，显著优于基于 SVD 与基于启发式的方法。

sentences.en: This work demonstrates that curvature-guided, geometry-aware sharing is essential for efficient, stable, and high-ratio model compression.
sentences.zh: 本工作表明，曲率引导的、几何感知的共享对于高效、稳定、高压缩率的模型压缩至关重要。

title_en: Rethinking Personalization in Large Language Models at the Token Level
title_zh: 在词元层级重新思考大语言模型的个性化

sentences.en: With large language models (LLMs) now performing strongly across diverse tasks, there is growing demand for them to personalize outputs for individual users.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）如今在多样化任务上表现强劲，人们对它们针对个人用户个性化输出的需求日益增长。

sentences.en: Personalization is typically framed as an additional layer on top of a base NLP task, requiring model responses to meet user-specific needs while still accomplishing the underlying task.
sentences.zh: 个性化通常被框定为基础 NLP 任务之上的额外一层，要求模型响应在满足用户特定需求的同时仍完成底层任务。

sentences.en: From a token-level perspective, different tokens in a response contribute to personalization to varying degrees.
sentences.zh: 从词元级的视角来看，响应中的不同词元对个性化的贡献程度各不相同。

sentences.en: Tokens with higher personalization relevance should therefore receive greater emphasis when developing personalized LLMs.
sentences.zh: 因此，在开发个性化 LLM 时，个性化相关性更高的词元应获得更大的重视。

sentences.en: However, accurately estimating such personalization degrees remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 然而，准确估计这种个性化程度仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose PerContrast, a self-contrast method that estimates each output token’s dependence on user-specific information through causal intervention.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出 PerContrast，一种自对比方法，它通过因果干预来估计每个输出词元对用户特定信息的依赖程度。

sentences.en: Building on this mechanism, we develop the PerCE loss, which adaptively upweights tokens with higher estimated personalization degrees during training via a bootstrap procedure, enabling the model to alternate between estimating and optimizing these tokens.
sentences.zh: 在这一机制的基础上，我们开发了 PerCE 损失，它通过引导过程在训练期间自适应地提高估计个性化程度更高的词元的权重，使模型能够在估计与优化这些词元之间交替。

sentences.en: Experiments on multiple LLMs demonstrate that PerCE substantially improves personalization performance with minimal additional cost, achieving average gains of over 10\% and up to 68.04\% on the LongLaMP dataset, along with strong cross-task and cross-scenario transferability.
sentences.zh: 在多个 LLM 上的实验表明，PerCE 以极小的额外成本大幅提升了个性化性能，在 LongLaMP 数据集上实现了平均超过 10\% 且最高达 68.04\% 的提升，并具有强跨任务与跨场景可迁移性。

sentences.en: These results highlight the importance of token-level personalization modeling and establish token-aware training as a simple yet effective paradigm for advancing personalized LLMs.
sentences.zh: 这些结果突显了词元级个性化建模的重要性，并确立了词元感知训练作为推进个性化 LLM 的一种简单而有效的范式。

title_en: Rethinking Pretraining Data Detection for LLMs: From Local to Global
title_zh: 重新思考 LLM 的预训练数据检测：从局部到全局

sentences.en: The advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs) are primarily attributed to massive pretraining data, which also introduces risks like privacy leakage and data contamination.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步主要归功于海量的预训练数据，而这些数据也引入了诸如隐私泄漏与数据污染之类的风险。

sentences.en: Therefore, it is crucial to determine whether an LLM has been trained on a given target text.
sentences.zh: 因此，判断一个 LLM 是否在给定目标文本上训练过至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing detection methods primarily rely on local statistics of isolated tokens (e.g., those with the lowest probabilities), neglecting the probability dynamics during the token generation process.
sentences.zh: 现有的检测方法主要依赖孤立词元的局部统计（例如概率最低的那些词元），忽视了词元生成过程中的概率动态。

sentences.en: In this paper, we shift the detection paradigm from a local token to a global sequence perspective, grounded in the core intuition that memorized sequences exhibit volatility patterns distinct from those generated via inference.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将检测范式从局部词元转向全局序列视角，其核心直觉是：被记忆的序列表现出与通过推理生成的序列截然不同的波动模式。

sentences.en: We propose Adaptive Entropic Convolutional Analysis (AECA), a framework that conceptualizes the probability sequence as a dynamic signal, integrating calibration with convolutional filtering to effectively capture memorization signals.
sentences.zh: 我们提出自适应熵卷积分析（Adaptive Entropic Convolutional Analysis，AECA），一个将概率序列概念化为动态信号的框架，它整合校准与卷积滤波，以有效捕获记忆化信号。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AECA surpasses previous methods by up to 1.5\% in average AUC on the WikiMIA benchmark, with its advantage being particularly pronounced in long-text scenarios.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，AECA 在 WikiMIA 基准上以高达 1.5\% 的平均 AUC 提升超越了先前方法，其优势在长文本场景中尤为显著。

title_en: Rethinking Serialization in Linear 3D Vision: Decoupling Anisotropic Geometry from Isotropic Semantics
title_zh: 重新思考线性 3D 视觉中的序列化：将各向异性几何与各向同性语义解耦

sentences.en: Current linear State-Space Models (SSMs) for 3D point clouds typically rely on 1D serialization schemes (e.g., Hilbert curves) for global modeling.
sentences.zh: 当前用于 3D 点云的线性状态空间模型（SSM）通常依赖一维序列化方案（例如希尔伯特曲线）进行全局建模。

sentences.en: In dense scenes, such imposed order can disrupt spatial continuity and induce what we call serialization bias.
sentences.zh: 在稠密场景中，这种强加的顺序可能破坏空间连续性，并诱发我们称之为序列化偏倚的现象。

sentences.en: We propose AnIsoNet, a framework that decouples anisotropic geometry from isotropic semantics via two dedicated modules: Local Anisotropy Geometric Modeling (LAGM) and Global Isotropy Semantic Aggregation (GISA).
sentences.zh: 我们提出 AnIsoNet，一个通过两个专用模块将各向异性几何与各向同性语义解耦的框架：局部各向异性几何建模（LAGM）与全局各向同性语义聚合（GISA）。

sentences.en: LAGM uses ellipsoidal encoding to capture local directionality without relying on global order.
sentences.zh: LAGM 使用椭球编码来捕获局部方向性，而不依赖全局顺序。

sentences.en: GISA is configured according to dataset-level geometric density: dense-scene datasets use Identity Mode to avoid additional geometry-driven re-serialization, whereas sparse-object datasets use Morton serialization to provide a lightweight spatial prior.
sentences.zh: GISA 根据数据集级的几何密度进行配置：稠密场景数据集使用恒等模式，以避免额外的几何驱动的重新序列化；而稀疏物体数据集使用 Morton 序列化以提供轻量级的空间先验。

sentences.en: This avoids redundant multi-view scanning while preserving O(N) complexity.
sentences.zh: 这避免了冗余的多视图扫描，同时保持 O(N) 复杂度。

sentences.en: On S3DIS, reducing artificial serialization in dense scenes yields 82.62% mIoU, surpassing PCM by 3.0%.
sentences.zh: 在 S3DIS 上，减少稠密场景中的人工序列化获得了 82.62% 的 mIoU，超过 PCM 3.0%。

sentences.en: On ScanObjectNN, Morton serialization for sparse objects reaches 94.21% OA (+1.6%).
sentences.zh: 在 ScanObjectNN 上，针对稀疏物体的 Morton 序列化达到了 94.21% 的 OA（+1.6%）。

sentences.en: On ScanNetV2, our model achieves 78.52% mIoU, surpassing PTv3 (77.5%) without pre-training, with only 12.2M parameters and 37G FLOPs.
sentences.zh: 在 ScanNetV2 上，我们的模型无需预训练即达到 78.52% 的 mIoU，超过 PTv3（77.5%），且仅需 12.2M 参数与 37G FLOPs。

title_en: Rethinking Sparse Mixture of Experts from a Unified Perspective
title_zh: 从统一视角重新思考稀疏混合专家

sentences.en: Sparse Mixture of Experts (SMoE) models scale the capacity of models while maintaining constant computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 稀疏混合专家（SMoE）模型在保持恒定的计算开销的同时扩展了模型的容量。

sentences.en: SMoE methods fall into two categories: *Token Choice*, which routes each token to a fixed number of experts, and *Expert Choice*, which assigns a fixed number of tokens to each expert.
sentences.zh: SMoE 方法分为两类：*词元选择*（Token Choice），它将每个词元路由到固定数量的专家；以及*专家选择*（Expert Choice），它为每个专家分配固定数量的词元。

sentences.en: However, the use of fixed budgets for tokens or experts causes both approaches to select irrelevant token–expert pairs or overlook critical assignments, which degrades overall performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，对词元或专家使用固定预算会让两种方法要么选择无关的词元-专家对，要么忽视关键分配，从而降低整体性能。

sentences.en: To fill that gap, we rethink SMoE from a *unified perspective* through the lens of *linear programming*, which provides a general formulation for SMoE models.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们从*线性规划*的视角以*统一视角*重新思考 SMoE，它为 SMoE 模型提供了一种一般化的表述。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce **Unified Sparse Mixture of Experts (USMoE)**, a novel framework comprising a *unified mechanism* and a *unified score* to overcome these limitations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入 **统一稀疏混合专家（Unified Sparse Mixture of Experts，USMoE）**，一个包含*统一机制*与*统一分数*的新框架，以克服这些局限。

sentences.en: We provide both theoretical justification and empirical evidence demonstrating USMoE's effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了理论依据与实证证据，证明 USMoE 的有效性。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations across diverse data settings (clean and corrupted), multiple domains (including texts and vision tasks), and different learning approaches (training-free and training-based) show that USMoE not only delivers significant performance improvements over existing SMoE methods, but also enables more flexible expert selection budgets, reducing inference costs without compromising model performance.
sentences.zh: 在多样的数据设置（干净与受污染）、多个领域（包括文本与视觉任务）以及不同学习方法（免训练与基于训练）上的广泛评估表明，USMoE 不仅相比现有 SMoE 方法带来了显著的性能提升，还实现了更灵活的专家选择预算，在无损模型性能的前提下降低了推理成本。

title_en: Rethinking Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning: From Prediction to Correspondence
title_zh: 重新思考视频目标中心学习中的时间一致性：从预测到对应

sentences.en: The de facto approach in video object-centric learning maintains temporal consistency through learned dynamics modules that predict future object representations, called slots.
sentences.zh: 视频目标中心学习中事实上的方法是通过学习到的动力学模块维持时间一致性，这些模块预测未来的目标表示（称为槽）。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that these predictors function as expensive approximations of discrete correspondence problems.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，这些预测器实际上是离散对应问题的昂贵近似。

sentences.en: Modern self-supervised vision backbones already encode instance-discriminative features that distinguish objects reliably.
sentences.zh: 现代自监督视觉骨干已经编码了能够可靠区分目标的实例判别性特征。

sentences.en: Exploiting these features eliminates the need for learned temporal prediction.
sentences.zh: 利用这些特征消除了学习时间预测的必要。

sentences.en: We introduce Grounded Correspondence, a framework that replaces learned transition functions with deterministic bipartite matching.
sentences.zh: 我们引入有根据的对应（Grounded Correspondence），一个用确定性二分匹配取代学习到的过渡函数的框架。

sentences.en: Slots initialize from salient regions in frozen backbone features.
sentences.zh: 槽从冻结骨干特征中的显著区域初始化。

sentences.en: Frame-to-frame identity is maintained through Hungarian matching on slot representations.
sentences.zh: 帧到帧的身份通过槽表示上的匈牙利匹配来维持。

sentences.en: The approach requires zero learnable parameters for temporal modeling yet achieves competitive performance on MOVi-D, MOVi-E, and YouTube-VIS.
sentences.zh: 这一方法在时间建模上需要零可学习参数，却在 MOVi-D、MOVi-E 与 YouTube-VIS 上取得了有竞争力的性能。

sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://magenta-sherbet-85b101.netlify.app/

title_en: Rethinking the Design Space of Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models: On the Importance of Likelihood Estimation Beyond Loss Design
title_zh: 重新思考扩散模型强化学习的设计空间：似然估计在损失设计之外的重要性

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning has been widely applied to diffusion and flow models for visual tasks such as text-to-image generation.
sentences.zh: 强化学习已被广泛应用于扩散与流模型，用于文本到图像生成等视觉任务。

sentences.en: However, these tasks remain challenging because diffusion models have intractable likelihoods, which creates a barrier for directly applying popular policy-gradient type methods.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些任务仍具挑战性，因为扩散模型具有难以处理的似然，这为直接应用流行的策略梯度类方法造成了障碍。

sentences.en: Existing approaches primarily focus on crafting new objectives built on already heavily engineered LLM objectives, using ad hoc estimators for likelihood, without a thorough investigation into how such estimation affects overall algorithmic performance.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要专注于在已经高度工程化的 LLM 目标之上构筑新目标，使用临时设计的似然估计器，而未曾深入调查这种估计如何影响整体算法性能。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of the RL design space by disentangling three factors: i) policy-gradient objectives, ii) likelihood estimators, and iii) rollout sampling schemes.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过解耦三个因素来系统分析 RL 设计空间：i）策略梯度目标，ii）似然估计器，以及 iii）滚出采样方案。

sentences.en: We show that adopting an evidence lower bound (ELBO) based model likelihood estimator, computed only from the final generated sample, is the dominant factor enabling effective, efficient, and stable RL optimization, outweighing the impact of the specific policy-gradient loss functional.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，采用基于证据下界（ELBO）的模型似然估计器——仅从最终生成的样本计算——是促使有效、高效且稳定的 RL 优化的主导因素，其影响超过了特定策略梯度损失泛函的影响。

sentences.en: We validate our findings across multiple reward benchmarks using SD 3.5 Medium, and observe consistent trends across all tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 SD 3.5 Medium 在多个奖励基准上验证了我们的发现，并在所有任务中观察到一致的趋势。

sentences.en: Our method improves the GenEval score from $0.24$ to $0.95$ in $90$ GPU hours, which is $4.6\times$ more efficient than FlowGRPO and $2\times$ more efficient than the SOTA method DiffusionNFT without reward hacking.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将 GenEval 分数从 $0.24$ 提升到 $0.95$，仅用时 $90$ GPU 小时，其效率是 FlowGRPO 的 $4.6\times$，也是最先进方法 DiffusionNFT 的 $2\times$，且无奖励黑客行为。

title_en: Rethinking the Flow-based Gradual Domain Adaptation: A Semi-Dual Optimal Transport Perspective
title_zh: 重新思考基于流的渐进域适应：一种半对偶最优输运视角

sentences.en: Gradual domain adaptation (GDA) aims to mitigate domain shift by progressively adapting models from the source domain to the target domain via intermediate domains.
sentences.zh: 渐进域适应（GDA）旨在通过中间域渐进地将模型从源域适应到目标域，以缓解域偏移。

sentences.en: However, real intermediate domains are often unavailable or ineffective, necessitating the synthesis of intermediate samples.
sentences.zh: 然而，真实的中间域往往不可用或无效，因此有必要合成中间样本。

sentences.en: Flow-based models have recently been used for this purpose by interpolating between source and target distributions.
sentences.zh: 基于流的模型近来被用于此目的，通过在源分布与目标分布之间进行插值。

sentences.en: Notably, their training typically relies on sample-based log-likelihood estimation, which can discard useful information and thus degrade GDA performance.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，它们的训练通常依赖基于样本的对数似然估计，这可能丢弃有用信息，从而降低 GDA 性能。

sentences.en: The key to addressing this limitation is constructing the intermediate domains via samples directly.
sentences.zh: 解决这一局限的关键在于直接通过样本来构建中间域。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose an $\underline{\text{E}}$ntropy-regularized $\underline{\text{S}}$emi-dual $\underline{\text{U}}$nbalanced $\underline{\text{O}}$ptimal $\underline{\text{T}}$ransport (E-SUOT) framework to construct intermediate domains.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出一个$\underline{\text{E}}$熵正则化 $\underline{\text{S}}$半对偶 $\underline{\text{U}}$非平衡 $\underline{\text{O}}$最优 $\underline{\text{T}}$输运（E-SUOT）框架来构建中间域。

sentences.en: Specifically, we reformulate flow-based GDA as a Lagrangian dual problem and derive an equivalent semi-dual objective that circumvents the need for likelihood estimation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们将基于流的 GDA 重新表述为一个拉格朗日对偶问题，并推导出一个等价的半对偶目标，从而回避了对似然估计的需求。

sentences.en: However, the dual problem leads to an unstable min–max training procedure.
sentences.zh: 然而，对偶问题会导致不稳定的极小-极大训练过程。

sentences.en: To alleviate this issue, we further introduce the entropy regularization to convert it into a more stable sequential optimization procedure.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们进一步引入熵正则化，将其转化为更稳定的顺序优化过程。

sentences.en: Based on this, we propose a novel GDA training framework and provide theoretical analysis in terms of stability and generalization.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出一个新颖的 GDA 训练框架，并在稳定性与泛化方面提供理论分析。

sentences.en: Finally, extensive experiments are conducted to demonstrate the efficacy of the E-SUOT framework.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们进行了大量实验，以证明 E-SUOT 框架的有效性。
